## Define Functions for DDM Analysis
```{r}
# Functions
test.params <- function(df) {
  inner_join(inner_join(inner_join(df %>%
                                     map_dfr(mean) %>%
                                     gather(parameter, estimate, everything()) %>% dplyr::rename(Mean=estimate),
                                   df %>%
                                     map_dfr(sd) %>%
                                     gather(parameter, estimate, everything()) %>% dplyr::rename(SD=estimate),by='parameter'),
                        
                        df %>% map(~ .x > 0) %>% 
                          map_dfr(mean) %>%
                          gather(parameter, pvalue, everything()) %>%
                          mutate(pvalue = if_else(round(pvalue)==1, 1-pvalue, pvalue),
                                 sig = if_else(pvalue < 0.001, "***",
                                               if_else(pvalue < 0.01, "**",
                                                       if_else(pvalue < 0.05, "*", "n.s."))))),
             inner_join(df %>%
                          map_dfr(function(x) return(quantile(x,0.975)[[1]])) %>%
                          gather(parameter, estimate, everything()) %>% dplyr::rename(CI_upper=estimate),
                        df %>% map_dfr(function(x) return(quantile(x,0.025)[[1]])) %>%
                          gather(parameter, estimate, everything()) %>% dplyr::rename(CI_lower=estimate),by='parameter'),by='parameter')
} 

# Define the summary posterior function
summarize_posterior <- function(V1, V2, effect) {
  post <- as.data.frame(V1 - V2)
  ggplot2::ggplot(data = post, aes(x = `V1 - V2`)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", size = 1) +
    labs(title = paste(effect, "p<0 = ", length(post[post < 0]) / length(post$`V1 - V2`))) +
    theme_classic()
}

multiplot <- function(..., plotlist = NULL, file, cols = 1, layout = NULL) {
  library(grid)

  # Make a list from the ... arguments and plotlist
  plots <- c(list(...), plotlist)

  numPlots <- length(plots)

  # If layout is NULL, then use 'cols' to determine layout
  if (is.null(layout)) {
    # Make the panel
    # ncol: Number of columns of plots
    # nrow: Number of rows needed, calculated from # of cols
    layout <- matrix(seq(1, cols * ceiling(numPlots / cols)),
      ncol = cols, nrow = ceiling(numPlots / cols)
    )
  }

  if (numPlots == 1) {
    print(plots[[1]])
  } else {
    # Set up the page
    grid.newpage()
    pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(nrow(layout), ncol(layout))))

    # Make each plot, in the correct location
    for (i in 1:numPlots) {
      # Get the i,j matrix positions of the regions that contain this subplot
      matchidx <- as.data.frame(which(layout == i, arr.ind = TRUE))

      print(plots[[i]], vp = viewport(
        layout.pos.row = matchidx$row,
        layout.pos.col = matchidx$col
      ))
    }
  }
}
```

## Define plot_beta functions
```{r def_plot_beta_function, include=FALSE}
plot_betas <- function(beta_name, df_name, phase_name) {
  # All intervals
  dfwc <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(df_name,
    measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catRewardLevel", "catPenaltyLevel"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = .95
  )
  dfwc.rew <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(df_name,
    measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catRewardLevel"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = .95
  )
  dfwc.pen <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(df_name,
    measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catPenaltyLevel"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = .95
  )

  # 2x2 All Intervals
  p.cond <- ggplot(data = dfwc, aes_string(x = "catPenaltyLevel", y = beta_name, group = "catRewardLevel", fill = "catRewardLevel")) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_line(position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 10, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, "All Intervals", phase_name)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catRewardLevel", values = colors.greens) +
    th_custom +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.80, 0.20))

  # Reward All Intervals
  p.REW <- ggplot(data = dfwc.rew, aes_string(x = "catRewardLevel", y = beta_name, fill = "catRewardLevel")) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 10, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catRewardLevel", values = colors.greens) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, "All Intervals", phase_name)) +
    th_custom +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.80, 0.20))

  # Penalty All Intervals
  p.PEN <- ggplot(data = dfwc.pen, aes_string(x = "catPenaltyLevel", y = beta_name, fill = "catPenaltyLevel")) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 10, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catPenaltyLevel", values = colors.reds) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, "All Intervals Cue", phase_name)) +
    th_custom +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.80, 0.20))

  # Save Plots
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", 
    beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_all_conditions.png"),
    plot = p.cond, device = "png", width = 4, height = 4, scale = 1
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", 
    beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_all_conditions.eps"),
    plot = p.cond, device = "eps", width = 4, height = 4
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", 
    beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_reward.png"),
    plot = p.REW, device = "png", width = 4, height = 4, scale = 1
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", 
    beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_reward.eps"),
    plot = p.REW, device = "eps", width = 4, height = 4
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", 
    beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_penalty.png"),
    plot = p.PEN, device = "png", width = 4, height = 4, scale = 1
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", 
    beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_penalty.eps"),
    plot = p.PEN, device = "eps", width = 4, height = 4
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_AllIntervals.png"),
    plot = p.cond, device = "png", width = 6, height = 6, scale = 1
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_AllIntervals.eps"),
    plot = p.cond, device = "eps", width = 6, height = 6, scale = 1
  )

  # Plot
  plot_grid(p.cond, p.REW, p.PEN, ncol = 3)
}

plot_betas_cue <- function(beta_name) {
  # All intervals
  dfwc <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(df.interval.cue,
    measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catRewardLevel", "catPenaltyLevel"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = .95
  )
  dfwc.rew <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(df.interval.cue,
    measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catRewardLevel"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = .95
  )
  dfwc.pen <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(df.interval.cue,
    measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catPenaltyLevel"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = .95
  )
  # No Errors
  dfwc.NE <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(df.interval.cue.noError,
    measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catRewardLevel", "catPenaltyLevel"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = .95
  )
  dfwc.NE.rew <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(df.interval.cue.noError,
    measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catRewardLevel"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = .95
  )
  dfwc.NE.pen <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(df.interval.cue.noError,
    measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catPenaltyLevel"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = .95
  )

  # 2x2 All Intervals Included
  p.cond <- ggplot(data = dfwc, aes_string(x = "catPenaltyLevel", y = beta_name, group = "catRewardLevel", fill = "catRewardLevel")) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 6, position = position_dodge(.1)) +

  # 2x2 No Errors
  p.cond.NE <- ggplot(data = dfwc.NE, aes_string(x = "catPenaltyLevel", y = beta_name, group = "catRewardLevel", fill = "catRewardLevel")) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 6, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_line(position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catRewardLevel", values = colors.blues) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, "No Errors")) +
    th_custom

  # Reward All Intervals
  p.REW <- ggplot(data = dfwc.rew, aes_string(x = "catRewardLevel", y = beta_name, fill = "catRewardLevel")) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 6, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catRewardLevel", values = colors.greens) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, "All Intervals Included")) +
    th_custom

  # Reward No Errors
  p.REW.NE <- ggplot(data = dfwc.NE.rew, aes_string(x = "catRewardLevel", y = beta_name, fill = "catRewardLevel")) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 6, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catRewardLevel", values = colors.greens) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, "No Errors")) +
    th_custom

  # Penalty All Intervals
  p.PEN <- ggplot(data = dfwc.pen, aes_string(x = "catPenaltyLevel", y = beta_name, fill = "catPenaltyLevel")) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 6, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catPenaltyLevel", values = colors.reds) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, "All Intervals Included")) +
    th_custom

  # Penalty No Errors
  p.PEN.NE <- ggplot(data = dfwc.NE.pen, aes_string(x = "catPenaltyLevel", y = beta_name, fill = "catPenaltyLevel")) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 6, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catPenaltyLevel", values = colors.reds) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, "No Errors")) +
    th_custom

  # Plot the Reward and Penalty Effects
  p1 <- plot_grid(p.cond, p.cond.NE)
  p2 <- plot_grid(p.REW, p.REW.NE)
  p3 <- plot_grid(p.PEN, p.PEN.NE)
  cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 1)
}

  # Penalty No Errors
  p.PEN.NE <- ggplot(data = dfwc.NE.pen, aes_string(x = "catPenaltyLevel", y = beta_name, fill = "catPenaltyLevel")) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 5, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catPenaltyLevel", values = colors.reds) +
    labu(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, "No Errors")) +
    th_custom

  # Plot the Reward and Penalty Effects
  p1 <- plot_grid(p.cond, p.cond.NE)
  p2 <- plot_grid(p.REW, p.REW.NE)
  p3 <- plot_grid(p.PEN, p.PEN.NE)
  plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 1)
}

plot_betas_fixed <- function(beta_name, df_name, phase_name) {
  # All intervals
  dfwc.rew <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(df_name,
    measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catRewardLevel", "catBlockType"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = .95
  )
  dfwc.pen <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(df_name,
    measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catPenaltyLevel", "catBlockType"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = .95
  )
  dfwc.rewpen <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(
    data = df_name, measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catRewardLevel", "catPenaltyLevel", "catBlockType"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = 0.95
  )

  # Change the facet labels to "Rew-Varying" and "Pen-Varying"
  new_block_labels <- c("fixedPenalty" = "Reward Varying", "fixedReward" = "Penalty Varying")

  # Reward All Intervals
  p.REW <- ggplot(data = dfwc.rew, aes_string(x = "catBlockType", y = beta_name, fill = "catRewardLevel")) +
    geom_path(aes_string(group = "catRewardLevel"), position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 6, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catRewardLevel", values = colors.greens) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, " ", phase_name)) +
    th_custom +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.15, 0.10))

  # Penalty All Intervals
  p.PEN <- ggplot(data = dfwc.pen, aes_string(x = "catBlockType", y = beta_name, fill = "catPenaltyLevel")) +
    geom_path(aes_string(group = "catPenaltyLevel"), position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 6, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catPenaltyLevel", values = colors.reds) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, " ", phase_name)) +
    th_custom +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.15, 0.10))


  p.REWPEN1 <- ggplot(data = dfwc.rewpen, aes_string(x = "catPenaltyLevel", y = beta_name, fill = "catRewardLevel", shape = "catPenaltyLevel")) +
    facet_grid(. ~ catBlockType) +
    geom_path(aes_string(group = "catRewardLevel"), position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = catRewardLevel, shape = catPenaltyLevel, color = catRewardLevel), size = 6, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catRewardLevel", values = colors.greens) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "catRewardLevel", values = colors.greens) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(22, 21)) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, " ", phase_name)) +
    th_custom +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.15, 0.10))

  p.REWPEN2 <- ggplot(data = dfwc.rewpen, aes_string(x = "catRewardLevel", y = beta_name, fill = "catPenaltyLevel", shape = "catRewardLevel")) +
    facet_grid(. ~ catBlockType) +
    geom_path(aes_string(group = "catPenaltyLevel"), position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = paste0(beta_name, "+se"), min = paste0(beta_name, "-se")), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = catPenaltyLevel, shape = catRewardLevel, color = catPenaltyLevel), size = 6, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catPenaltyLevel", values = colors.reds) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "catPenaltyLevel", values = colors.reds) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(22, 21)) +
    labs(x = " ", y = beta_name, title = paste(beta_name, " ", phase_name)) +
    th_custom +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.15, 0.10))

  # Save Plots
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_Fixed_reward.png"),
    plot = p.REW, device = "png", width = 6, height = 5, scale = 1
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_Fixed_reward.eps"),
    plot = p.REW, device = "eps", width = 6, height = 5
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_Fixed_penalty.png"),
    plot = p.PEN, device = "png", width = 6, height = 5, scale = 1
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_Fixed_penalty.eps"),
    plot = p.PEN, device = "eps", width = 6, height = 5
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_Fixed_rewardpenalty1.png"),
    plot = p.REWPEN1, device = "png", width = 12, height = 8, scale = 1
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_Fixed_rewardpenalty1.eps"),
    plot = p.REWPEN1, device = "eps", width = 12, height = 8
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_Fixed_rewardpenalty2.png"),
    plot = p.REWPEN2, device = "png", width = 12, height = 8, scale = 1
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_Fixed_rewardpenalty2.eps"),
    plot = p.REWPEN2, device = "eps", width = 12, height = 8
  )

  # Plot
  list(plot_grid(p.REW, p.PEN, ncol = 2), p.REWPEN1, p.REWPEN2)
}

plot_betas_rewvarying <- function(beta_name, df_name, phase_name) {
  
  dfwc.rewpen <- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(
    data = df_name, measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catRewardLevel", "catPenaltyLevel", "catBlockType"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = 0.95) %>% 
    filter(catBlockType == "VaryReward")
  
  roi_errorbarmax = paste0(beta_name, "+se")
  roi_errorbarmin = paste0(beta_name, "-se")

  p.rewpen<-ggplot(data = dfwc.rewpen, aes_string(x = "catPenaltyLevel", y = beta_name, fill = "catRewardLevel")) +
    geom_path(aes(group = .data[["catRewardLevel"]]), position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = roi_errorbarmax, min = roi_errorbarmin), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 10, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    #geom_point(aes(colour=catRewardLevel, size=catPenaltyLevel, shape=catPenaltyLevel), position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "catRewardLevel", values = colors.greens) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "catRewardLevel", values = colors.greens) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(15, 18)) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c(6, 9)) +
    labs(x = " ", y = "Beta Estimate", title = paste0(beta_name, " ",phase_name," by Incentive Condition")) +
    th_custom + 
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 14), 
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
          panel.border = element_blank(), 
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
          axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
          legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.position = "inside",
          legend.position.inside = c(0.8,0.2)) 
    
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_RewardVarying.png"),
      plot = p.rewpen, device = "png", width = 6, height = 6, scale = 1
    )

    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript, "fMRI/", beta_name, "_", phase_name, "_RewardVarying.eps"),
      plot = p.rewpen, device = "eps", width = 6, height = 6, scale = 1
    )

  # Plot
  list(p.rewpen)
}
```

-   All data (SRM, Likert, fMRI, DDM) formatted in "2_TCB-Manuscript-FormatData.Rmd"
```{r}
## INPUT DATA

# date for compiled data
date <- "20250220"

# Formatted SRM (Note Contains all subjects)
datapath.SRM <- paste0("data/qualtrics/formatted/data_fMRI-TCB_RewardPenalty_SRM_formatted_", date, ".csv")

# Formatted Likert

# Formatted Behavior Only (Trial and Interval)
datapath.trial <- paste0("data/behavior/formatted/data_fMRI-TCB_RewardPenalty_Trial_formatted_", date, ".csv")
datapath.interval <- paste0("data/behavior/formatted/data_fMRI-TCB_RewardPenalty_Interval_formatted_", date, ".csv")

df.interval <- fread(datapath.interval)

# Formatted Combined Behavior, fMRI, and Likert Ratings
datapath.trial.betas <- paste0("data/combined/data_fMRI-TCB_RewardPenalty_Trial_betas_formatted_", date, ".csv")
datapath.interval.betas <- paste0("data/combined/data_fMRI-TCB_RewardPenalty_Interval_betas_formatted_", date, ".csv")

df.interval.betas.combined <- fread(datapath.interval.betas)

# Formatted DDM Results

## OUTPUT DATA

```

## Exclude Subjects
```{r}
# Exclude subjects 2018 and 2039 for incomplete data, as well as subjects without incomplete Likert Data
sub.exclude <- c(2018, 2039)
sub.likert <- unique(df.Likert$SubID)

df.SRM <- df.SRM %>% filter(!SubID %in% sub.exclude) %>% filter(SubID %in% sub.likert)
df.Likert <- df.Likert %>% filter(!SubID %in% sub.exclude) %>% filter(SubID %in% sub.likert)
df.trial <- df.trial %>% filter(!SubID %in% sub.exclude) %>% filter(SubID %in% sub.likert)
df.interval <- df.interval %>% filter(!SubID %in% sub.exclude) %>% filter(SubID %in% sub.likert)
df.trial.betas.combined <- df.trial.betas.combined %>% filter(!SubID %in% sub.exclude) %>% filter(SubID %in% sub.likert)
df.interval.betas.combined <- df.interval.betas.combined %>% filter(!SubID %in% sub.exclude) %>% filter(SubID %in% sub.likert)
```

## Add contrasts to data
Contrast coding: 
- Low Reward or Low Penalty = -1
- High Reward or High Penalty = 1
- Reward Varying or Penalty Varying = -1
```{r}
# Likert
df.Likert <- df.Likert %>%
  mutate(
    Reward = factor(Reward, levels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward"), labels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward")),
    Penalty = factor(Penalty, levels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty"), labels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty")),
    catRewardLevel = factor(Reward, levels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward"), labels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward")),
    catPenaltyLevel = factor(Penalty, levels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty"), labels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty")),    
  ) %>%
  group_by(SubID) %>%
  mutate(Arousal_mc = Arousal - mean(Arousal),
        Pleasantness_mc = Pleasantness - mean(Pleasantness),
        PosArousal = Arousal_mc / sqrt(2) + Pleasantness_mc / sqrt(2),
        NegArousal = Arousal_mc / sqrt(2) - Pleasantness_mc / sqrt(2),
        scaledPosArousal = scale(PosArousal, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE),
        scaledNegArousal = scale(NegArousal, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# apply contrast code
contrast.code <- contr.sum(2) * -1
contrasts(df.Likert$Reward) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.Likert$Penalty) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.Likert$catRewardLevel) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.Likert$catPenaltyLevel) <- contrast.code

# Behavior - Trial
df.trial <- df.trial %>%
  mutate(
    catRewardLevel = factor(RewardLevel, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward")),
    catPenaltyLevel = factor(PenaltyLevel, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty")),
    catBlockType = factor(catBlockType, levels = c("VaryPenalty", "VaryReward"), labels = c("VaryPenalty", "VaryReward")),
    Sex = as.factor(x = Sex)
  ) 
# apply contrast code
contrast.code <- contr.sum(2) * -1
contrasts(df.trial$catRewardLevel) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.trial$catPenaltyLevel) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.trial$Sex) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.trial$catBlockType) <- contrast.code

# Behavior - Interval
df.interval <- df.interval %>%
  mutate(
    catRewardLevel = factor(catRewardLevel, levels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward"), labels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward")),
    catPenaltyLevel = factor(catPenaltyLevel, levels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty"), labels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty")),
    catBlockType = factor(catBlockType, levels = c("VaryPenalty", "VaryReward"), labels = c("VaryPenalty", "VaryReward")),
    Sex = as.factor(x = Sex)
  )

contrast.code <- contr.sum(2) * -1
contrasts(df.interval$catRewardLevel) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.interval$catPenaltyLevel) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.interval$catBlockType) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.interval$Sex) <- contrast.code

# Combined Behavior (Trial + Betas)
df.trial.betas.combined <- df.trial.betas.combined %>%
  mutate(
    catRewardLevel = factor(RewardLevel, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward")),
    catPenaltyLevel = factor(PenaltyLevel, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty")),
    catBlockType = factor(block_type, levels = c("VaryPenalty", "VaryReward"), labels = c("VaryPenalty", "VaryReward"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(y = subset(x = df.Likert, select = c(SubID,catRewardLevel,catPenaltyLevel,PosArousal,NegArousal,scaledPosArousal,scaledNegArousal)), by = c("SubID","catRewardLevel","catPenaltyLevel"), relationship = "many-to-many")

# apply contrast code
contrast.code <- contr.sum(2) * -1
contrasts(df.trial.betas.combined$catRewardLevel) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.trial.betas.combined$catPenaltyLevel) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.trial.betas.combined$catBlockType) <- contrast.code

# Combined Behavior (Interval + Betas)
df.interval.betas.combined <- df.interval.betas.combined %>%
  mutate(
    catRewardLevel = factor(catRewardLevel, levels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward"), labels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward")),
    catPenaltyLevel = factor(catPenaltyLevel, levels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty"), labels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty")),
    catBlockType = factor(catBlockType, levels = c("VaryPenalty", "VaryReward"), labels = c("VaryPenalty", "VaryReward"))
  )  %>%
  left_join(y = subset(x = df.Likert, select = c(SubID,catRewardLevel,catPenaltyLevel,PosArousal,NegArousal,scaledPosArousal,scaledNegArousal)), by = c("SubID","catRewardLevel","catPenaltyLevel"), relationship = "many-to-many")


# apply contrast code
contrast.code <- contr.sum(2) * -1
contrasts(df.interval.betas.combined$catRewardLevel) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.interval.betas.combined$catPenaltyLevel) <- contrast.code
contrasts(df.interval.betas.combined$catBlockType) <- contrast.code
```

## Mixed Effects Models for Cue Betas
```{r}
# Ventral Striatum - Buildmer to determine best random effects
formula.STR.max <- scaled_Bilateral_Striatum  ~ catRewardLevel * catPenatlyLevel +
  scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum +
  (1 + catPenaltyLevel + catRewardLevel | SubID)
m.STR <- buildmer(
  formula = formula.STR.max, data = df.interval.cue,
  buildmerControl = buildmerControl(
    direction = "order", include = ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
      scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum,
    calc.anova = TRUE, ddf = "Satterthwaite"
  )
)
m.STR.VaryReward <- buildmer(
  formula = formula.STR.max, data = subset(df.interval.cue, catBlockType == "VaryReward"),
  buildmerControl = buildmerControl(
    direction = "order", include = ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
      scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum,
    calc.anova = TRUE, ddf = "Satterthwaite"
  )
)
m.STR.VaryPenalty <- buildmer(
  formula = formula.STR.max, data = subset(df.interval.cue, catBlockType == "VaryPenalty"),
  buildmerControl = buildmerControl(
    direction = "order", include = ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
      scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum,
    calc.anova = TRUE, ddf = "Satterthwaite"
  )
)
summary(m.STR)
summary(m.STR.VaryReward)
summary(m.STR.VaryPenalty)

# Ventral Striatum - Final models
model.STR <- lmer(
  formula = scaled_Bilateral_Striatum ~ 1 + catRewardLevel + catPenaltyLevel +  
    catRewardLevel:catPenaltyLevel + scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength +  
    scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 + catPenaltyLevel | SubID),
  data = df.interval.cue,
  REML = FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer = "optimx", optCtrl = list(method = "nlminb"))
)
model.STR.VaryReward <- lmer(
  formula = scaled_Bilateral_Striatum ~ 1 + catRewardLevel + catPenaltyLevel +  
    catRewardLevel:catPenaltyLevel + scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength +  
    scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 + catPenaltyLevel | SubID),

)
model.STR.VaryPenalty <- lmer(

    scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 + catRewardLevel | SubID),

)
tab_model(model.STR, model.STR.VaryReward, model.STR.VaryPenalty,

)

  REML = FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer = "optimx", optCtrl = list(method = "nlminb"))
)
model.dACCctrl.VaryPenalty <- lmer(
```

```{r}
anova(model.dACCctrl.VaryPenalty) %>% kable(caption = "Rostral dACC Interval - Penalty Varying") %>% kable_styling()
```

## Forest Plot Interval Betas
```{r}
p.ROIInt<-plot_models(model.STR, model.AI, model.dACCsal, model.dACCctrl, model.dlPFCsal, model.IFG,
  m.labels = c("Ventral Striatum","Anterior Insula","Caudal dACC","Rostral dACC","Dorsolateral PFC","Inferior Frontal Gyrus"),
  rm.terms = c("scaledIntervalCong","scaledIntervalLength","scaledIntervalSessionNum"),
  #order.terms = c(3,1,2),
  legend.title = "ROIs", axis.labels = c("Reward x Penalty", "Penalty", "Reward"),
  colors = "Set2", dot.size = 5,
  title = "Interval Related Neural Activity",
  show.values = FALSE, show.p = FALSE, p.shape = TRUE)  
p.ROIInt <- p.ROIInt + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.060, 0.060)) +
  th_plotbetas + 
  scale_fill_npg() +
  scale_color_npg() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
p.ROIInt

ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"fMRI/ROI_Int_ForestPlot.png"), 
      plot = p.ROIInt, device = "png", width = 10, height = 10, scale = 1)
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"fMRI/ROI_Int_ForestPlot.eps"), 
      plot = p.ROIInt, device = "eps", width = 10, height = 10, scale = 1)
```

```{r}
# Ventral Striatum
beta_name = "Bilateral_Striatum"
roi_errorbarmax = paste0(beta_name, "+se")
roi_errorbarmin = paste0(beta_name, "-se")
df.STR.cue.rewpen<- Rmisc::summarySEwithin(
    data = df.interval.cue, measurevar = beta_name,
    withinvars = c("catRewardLevel", "catPenaltyLevel", "catBlockType"),
    idvar = "SubID", na.rm = TRUE, conf.interval = 0.95) %>% 
    filter(catBlockType == "VaryReward")
p.STR.cue.rewpen<-ggplot(data = df.STR.cue.rewpen, aes_string(x = "catPenaltyLevel", y = beta_name, fill = "catRewardLevel")) +
    geom_path(aes(group = .data[["catRewardLevel"]]), position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes_string(max = roi_errorbarmax, min = roi_errorbarmin), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    geom_point(shape = 22, size = 8, position = position_dodge(.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = colors.greens) +
    labs(x = " ", y = "Beta Estimate", title = paste0("Ventral Striatum (Cue)")) +
    th_plotbetas
```

```{r, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# Striatum
model.STR.stan<-stan_lmer(formula = scaled_Bilateral_Striatum ~ 1 + catPenaltyLevel + catRewardLevel +  
    catPenaltyLevel:catRewardLevel + catBlockType + catPenaltyLevel:catBlockType +  
    catRewardLevel:catBlockType + catPenaltyLevel:catRewardLevel:catBlockType +  
    scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum +  
    (1 + catRewardLevel + catPenaltyLevel | SubID), 
  data = df.interval.cue,
  chains = 4, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, thin = 1, seed = 12345)
model.STR.VaryReward.stan<-stan_lmer(formula = scaled_Bilateral_Striatum ~ 1 + catPenaltyLevel + catRewardLevel +  
    catPenaltyLevel:catRewardLevel + 
    scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum +  
    (1 + catPenaltyLevel | SubID),

model.STR.VaryPenalty.stan<-stan_lmer(formula = scaled_Bilateral_Striatum ~ 1 + catPenaltyLevel + catRewardLevel +
```

## Subjective Affect and Motivation Ratings Predict Neural Actvity
### Individual Self Report Ratings
* Pleasantness: How unpleasant/negative or pleasant/positive it made you feel
* Arousal: How relaxed/calm or stimulated/aroused it made you feel
* Motivation: How MOTIVATED you were
* Difficulty" How DIFFICULT the task was 
* Effort: How much EFFORT you exerted
* Attention: How much you paid attention

### Valence - Arousal 2D Plot
```{r}
# # Compute Positive and Negative Arousal for each subject
# df.Likert.ValAro <- df.Likert %>% 
#   group_by(SubID) %>%
#   mutate(Arousal_mc = Arousal - mean(Arousal),
#         Pleasantness_mc = Pleasantness - mean(Pleasantness),
#         PosArousal = Arousal_mc / sqrt(2) + Pleasantness_mc / sqrt(2),
#         NegArousal = Arousal_mc / sqrt(2) - Pleasantness_mc / sqrt(2)) %>%
#   ungroup()

# Plot group level valence and arousal scores
summary.ValenceArousal<- summary.pleasant %>% 
  inner_join(summary.arousal, by = c("Reward","Penalty","N")) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = case_when(
      Reward == "Low Reward" & Penalty == "Low Penalty" ~ "Low Reward \n Low Penalty",
      Reward == "Low Reward" & Penalty == "High Penalty" ~ "Low Reward \n High Penalty",
      Reward == "High Reward" & Penalty == "Low Penalty" ~ "High Reward \n Low Penalty",
      Reward == "High Reward" & Penalty == "High Penalty" ~ "High Reward \n High Penalty"),
    Arousal_mc = Arousal - mean(Arousal),
    Pleasantness_mc = Pleasantness - mean(Pleasantness),
    PosArousal = Arousal_mc/sqrt(2) + Pleasantness_mc/sqrt(2),
    NegArousal = Arousal_mc/sqrt(2) - Pleasantness_mc/sqrt(2),
    Hypotenuse = ifelse(Arousal > 0, round(sqrt(Pleasantness^2 + Arousal^2),3), -1*round(sqrt(Pleasantness^2 + Arousal^2),3))
  ) 

summary.ValenceArousal %>%
  select(Reward, Penalty, N, Pleasantness, Arousal, Hypotenuse, Pleasantness_mc,  Arousal_mc, PosArousal, NegArousal) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Helvetica")

plot.ValenceArousalLabel<-ggplot(summary.ValenceArousal, aes(x = Pleasantness, y = Arousal)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(max = Arousal+ci.y, min = Arousal-ci.y), width = 0.1, size = 0.6) + 
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = Pleasantness+ci.x, xmin = Pleasantness-ci.x), width = 0.1, size = 0.6) + 
  xlab(label = "Valence") + 
  geom_point(size = 7, colour = "black", aes(fill = Reward, shape = Penalty), stroke = 1) + 
  geom_point(size = 6, aes(colour = Reward, shape = Penalty)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "gray",) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "gray",) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = Pleasantness, yend = Arousal), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), size = .8) +
  geom_label(aes(label = Condition), nudge_x = -0.0, nudge_y = 1.0) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-4,4), xlim = c(-4,4)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors.greens) +
  th_plotlikert +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
plot.ValenceArousalLabel 


# TCB Manuscript Figure 1c Save Plots
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"Likert/ratings_valencearousal_label.png"), 
       plot = plot.ValenceArousalLabel, device = "png", width = 6, height = 6, scale = 1.2, dpi = 300)

       plot = plot.ValenceArousalLabel, device = "eps", width = 6, height = 6, scale = 1.2, dpi = 300)
```

### Self Report Ratings ~ Reward and Penalty
```{r}
#Run model for each rating
model.motivation = lmer(formula = scaledMotivation ~ Reward * Penalty + (1 | SubID), data = df.Likert)
model.effort = lmer(formula = scaledEffort ~ Reward * Penalty + (1 |SubID), data = df.Likert)
model.attention = lmer(formula = scaledAttention ~ Reward * Penalty + (1|SubID), data = df.Likert)
model.pleasant = lmer(formula = scaledPleasantness ~ Reward * Penalty + (1|SubID), data = df.Likert)
model.arousal = lmer(formula = scaledArousal ~ Reward * Penalty + (1|SubID), data = df.Likert)
model.difficult = lmer(formula = scaledDifficult ~ Reward * Penalty + (1|SubID), data = df.Likert)
model.meanmotivation = lmer(formula = scaledMeanMotivation ~ Reward * Penalty + (1|SubID), data = df.Likert)
model.PosArousal = lmer(formula = scaledPosArousal ~ Reward * Penalty + (1|SubID), data = df.Likert)
model.NegArousal = lmer(formula = scaledNegArousal ~ Reward * Penalty + (1|SubID), data = df.Likert)


# Visualize models
tab_model(model.pleasant, model.arousal, model.motivation, model.effort, model.attention, model.difficult, model.meanmotivation,
          show.re.var = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE, show.icc = FALSE, show.se = FALSE, show.ci = .95,
          p.style = "numeric_stars", p.threshold = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001), emph.p = TRUE, 
          dv.labels = c("Pleasantness", "Arousal", "Motivation", "Effort", "Attention", "Difficulty", "Motivation (Averaged)"),
          pred.labels = c("(Intercept)","Reward", "Penalty", "Reward:Penalty"),
          title = "Affect and Motivation Ratings Predicted by Incentive Conditions",
          use.viewer = TRUE)

# Save the models 
tab_model(model.pleasant, model.arousal, model.difficult,
          show.re.var = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE, show.icc = FALSE, show.se = FALSE, show.ci = .95,
          p.style = "numeric_stars", p.threshold = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001), emph.p = TRUE, 
          dv.labels = c("Pleasantness", "Arousal", "Difficulty"),
          pred.labels = c("(Intercept)","Reward", "Penalty", "Reward:Penalty"),
          title = "Affect and Motivation Ratings Predicted by Incentive Conditions",
          #file = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"Likert/model_MotEffAtt_ratings.doc"), 
          use.viewer = TRUE)

tab_model(model.motivation, model.effort, model.attention, model.meanmotivation,
          show.re.var = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE, show.icc = FALSE, show.se = FALSE, show.ci = .95,
          p.style = "numeric_stars", p.threshold = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001), emph.p = TRUE, 
          dv.labels = c("Motivation", "Effort", "Attention", "Motivation (Averaged)"),
          pred.labels = c("(Intercept)","Reward", "Penalty", "Reward:Penalty"),
          title = "Affect and Motivation Ratings Predicted by Incentive Conditions",
          #file = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"Likert/model_PleAroDif_ratings.doc"), 
          use.viewer = TRUE)

# Mean Motivation
tab_model(model.meanmotivation,
          show.re.var = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE, show.icc = FALSE, show.se = FALSE, show.ci = .95,
          p.style = "numeric_stars", p.threshold = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001), emph.p = TRUE, 
          show.re.var = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE, show.ci = FALSE, show.std = TRUE, 
          dv.labels = c("Motivation (Averaged)"),
          pred.labels = c("(Intercept)","Reward", "Penalty", "Reward:Penalty"),
          title = "Mean Motivation Rating Predicted by Incentive Conditions",
          use.viewer = TRUE)

# Positive and Negative Arousal
model.Rew.PosNegAro = lmer(formula = Reward ~ scaledPosArousal + scaledNegArousal + (1|SubID), data = df.Likert)
model.Rew.PosNegAro = lmer(formula = Penalty ~ scaledNegArousal * scaledPosArousal + (1|SubID), data = df.Likert)

tab_model(model.PosArousal, model.NegArousal,
          show.re.var = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE, show.icc = FALSE, show.se = FALSE, show.ci = .95,
          p.style = "numeric_stars", p.threshold = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001), emph.p = TRUE, 
          dv.labels = c("Positive Arousal","Negative Arousal"),
          pred.labels = c("(Intercept)","Reward", "Penalty", "Reward:Penalty"),
          title = "Postive and Negative Arousal Predicted by Incentive Conditions",
          use.viewer = TRUE)


# Stats for all Models
kable(anova(model.pleasant), caption = "Pleasantness Ratings") %>% kable_styling()            # Pleasantness
kable(anova(model.arousal), caption = "Arousal Ratings") %>% kable_styling()                  # Arousal
kable(anova(model.meanmotivation), caption = "Mean Motivation Ratings") %>% kable_styling()   # MeanMotivation

kable(anova(model.motivation), caption = "Motivation Ratings") %>% kable_styling()            # Motivation
kable(anova(model.effort), caption = "Effort Ratings") %>% kable_styling()                    # Effort
kable(anova(model.attention), caption = "Attention Ratings") %>% kable_styling()              # Attention
kable(anova(model.difficult), caption = "Difficulty Ratings")  %>% kable_styling()            # Difficulty
```

```{r}
  formula = scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal ~ 1 + scaledPosArousal + scaledNegArousal +
scaledPosArousal:catRewardLevel + scaledPosArousal:catPenaltyLevel + scaledNegArousal:catRewardLevel + scaledNegArousal:catPenaltyLevel +
  scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID),
  data = df.interval.int,
  REML = FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer = "optimx", optCtrl = list(method = "nlminb"))
)

model.PFCl_ctrlint.rating.pno <- lmer(
  formula = scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl ~ 1 + scaledPosArousal + scaledNegArousal +
scaledPosArousal:catRewardLevel + scaledPosArousal:catPenaltyLevel + scaledNegArousal:catRewardLevel + scaledNegArousal:catPenaltyLevel +
  scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID),
  data = df.interval.int,
  REML = FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer = "optimx", optCtrl = list(method = "nlminb"))
)

model.IFGint.rating.pno <- lmer(
  formula = scaled_Bilateral_IFG ~ 1 + scaledPosArousal + scaledNegArousal +
scaledPosArousal:catRewardLevel + scaledPosArousal:catPenaltyLevel + scaledNegArousal:catRewardLevel + scaledNegArousal:catPenaltyLevel +
  scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID),
  data = df.interval.int,
  REML = FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer = "optimx", optCtrl = list(method = "nlminb"))
)
```

```{r}
rownames(pmat_CueROIratings) <- c("Pleasant", "Arousal", "Motivation","Difficult")

pmat.cue<-pmat_CueROIratings %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column() %>%
  pivot_longer(-1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(rating = rowname, ROI = name, p_value = value)

corrmat.cue<-corrmat_CueROIratings %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% round(3) %>%
  rownames_to_column() %>%
  pivot_longer(-1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(rating = rowname, ROI = name, t_value = value) %>%
  left_join(pmat.cue, by = c("rating","ROI")) %>%
  mutate(significance = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "***", ifelse(p_value < 0.01, "**", ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", ""))),
        rating = fct_relevel(rating, c("Pleasant", "Arousal", "Motivation","Difficult")),
        ROI = fct_relevel(ROI, c("VS","AI","dACC-caudal","dACC-rostral","dlPFC","IFG"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ROI, y = rating, fill = t_value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%1.2f\n%s", t_value, significance)), size = 6, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue3", mid = "white", high = "red3") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "t-values of with Cue-Related ROI Activity") +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", size = 1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        )
```

### ROI ~ Self Report Ratings (Visualize Heatmap of values)
```{r}
# select all Likert ratings and compute correlation matrix 
df.interval.cue.corr <- df.interval.cue %>% 
  select(scaledPleasantness,scaledArousal,scaledMeanMotivation,scaledDifficult,
        scaled_Bilateral_Striatum,scaled_Bilateral_AI,scaled_dACC_sal,scaled_dACC_ctrl,
        scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal,scaled_Bilateral_IFG) %>%
  dplyr::rename("Pleasant" = "scaledPleasantness",
                "Arousal" = "scaledArousal",
                "Motivation" = "scaledMeanMotivation",
                "Difficult" = "scaledDifficult",
                "VS" = "scaled_Bilateral_Striatum",
                "AI" = "scaled_Bilateral_AI",
                "dACC-caudal" = "scaled_dACC_sal",
                "dACC-rostral" = "scaled_dACC_ctrl",
                "dlPFC" = "scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal",
                "IFG" = "scaled_Bilateral_IFG")
View(df.interval.cue.corr)

test = cor(df.interval.cue.corr)

corr.ratings.cue <- cor(df.interval.cue.corr)[c(1:4),c(5:10)]
View(corr.ratings.cue)

corrplot(cor(df.interval.cue.corr), method = "color", sig.level = 0.05)

use = "pairwise.complete.obs"


corr.ratings.cue %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% round(3) %>%
  rownames_to_column() %>%
  pivot_longer(-1) %>%
  mutate(rowname = fct_relevel(rowname, c("Pleasant", "Arousal", "Motivation","Difficult")),
        name = fct_relevel(name, c("VS","AI","dACC-caudal","dACC-rostral","dlPFC","IFG")),
        sig_text = case_when(p_value >= 0.05 ~ "ns",
                            p_value < 0.05 & p_value >= 0.01 ~ "*",
                            p_value < 0.01 & p_value >= 0.001 ~ "**",
                            p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                            TRUE ~ "error")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = name, y = rowname, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = value), size = 5) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue3", mid = "white", high = "red3") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Correlation with Cue-Related ROI Activity") +
  #th_custom +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", size = 1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        )


# Sample data

# Calculate correlation matrix and p-values
cor_matrix <- corr.test(df.interval.cue.corr, method = "pearson")

coef(summary(model.STRcue.rating))["scaledPleasantness","t value"]
coef(summary(model.STRcue.rating))["scaledArousal","t value"]
coef(summary(model.STRcue.rating.mot))["scaledMeanMotivation","t value"]
coef(summary(model.STRcue.rating.))
```

### ROI ~ Self Report Ratings (Diff Scores)
```{r}
# Reward
df.diff.rew <- df.interval.cue %>%
  group_by(SubID,catRewardLevel) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(scaledMeanMotivation = mean(scaledMeanMotivation, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledMotivation = mean(scaledMotivation, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledEffort = mean(scaledEffort, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledAttention = mean(scaledAttention, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledDifficult = mean(scaledDifficult, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledPleasantness = mean(scaledPleasantness, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledArousal = mean(scaledArousal, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scale_Interval_log10_AccRT = mean(scale_Interval_log10_AccRT, na.rm = TRUE),
                  Interval_log10_AccRT = mean(Interval_log10_AccRT, na.rm = TRUE),
                  Interval_Acc = mean(Interval_Acc, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaled_Bilateral_Striatum = mean(scaled_Bilateral_Striatum, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaled_Bilateral_AI = mean(scaled_Bilateral_AI, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaled_dACC_sal = mean(scaled_dACC_sal, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaled_dACC_ctrl = mean(scaled_dACC_ctrl, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal = mean(scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl = mean(scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaled_Bilateral_IFG = mean(scaled_Bilateral_IFG, na.rm = TRUE),
                  .groups="keep") %>%
  mutate(catRewardLevel = factor(catRewardLevel, levels = c("Low Reward","High Reward"), labels = c("Low","High"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = catRewardLevel, 
              values_from = c(scaledMeanMotivation, 
                              scaledMotivation,
                              scaledEffort, 
                              scaledAttention, 
                              scaledDifficult, 
                              scaledPleasantness, 
                              scaledArousal, 
                              scale_Interval_log10_AccRT, 
                              Interval_log10_AccRT,
                              Interval_Acc,
                              scaled_Bilateral_Striatum, 
                              scaled_Bilateral_AI,
                              scaled_dACC_sal,
                              scaled_dACC_ctrl,
                              scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal,
                              scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl,
                              scaled_Bilateral_IFG)) %>%
  mutate(scaledMeanMotivation_RewDiff = scaledMeanMotivation_High - scaledMeanMotivation_Low,
        scaledMotivation_RewDiff = scaledMotivation_High - scaledMotivation_Low,
        scaledEffort_RewDiff = scaledEffort_High - scaledEffort_Low,

        scaledArousal_RewDiff= scaledArousal_High - scaledArousal_Low,
        scale_Interval_log10_AccRT_RewDiff = scale_Interval_log10_AccRT_High - scale_Interval_log10_AccRT_Low,
        Interval_log10_AccRT_RewDiff = Interval_log10_AccRT_High - Interval_log10_AccRT_Low,
        Interval_Acc_RewDiff = Interval_Acc_High - Interval_Acc_Low,
        scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_RewDiff = scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_High - scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_Low, 
        scaled_Bilateral_AI_RewDiff = scaled_Bilateral_AI_High - scaled_Bilateral_AI_Low,
        scaled_dACC_sal_RewDiff = scaled_dACC_sal_High - scaled_dACC_sal_Low,
        scaled_dACC_ctrl_RewDiff = scaled_dACC_ctrl_High - scaled_dACC_ctrl_Low,
        scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_RewDiff = scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_High - scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_Low,
        scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl_RewDiff = scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl_High - scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl_Low,
        scaled_Bilateral_IFG_RewDiff = scaled_Bilateral_IFG_High - scaled_Bilateral_IFG_Low)

        scaled_dACC_ctrl_PenDiff = scaled_dACC_ctrl_High - scaled_dACC_ctrl_Low,
        scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_PenDiff = scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_High - scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_Low,
        scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl_PenDiff = scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl_High - scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl_Low,
        scaled_Bilateral_IFG_PenDiff = scaled_Bilateral_IFG_High - scaled_Bilateral_IFG_Low)


# Reward Difference Models
model.STR.rating_RewDiff <- lm(scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_RewDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_RewDiff + scaledArousal_RewDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_RewDiff, data = df.diff.rew)
model.AI.rating_RewDiff <- lm(scaled_Bilateral_AI_RewDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_RewDiff + scaledArousal_RewDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_RewDiff, data = df.diff.rew)
model.dACCsal.rating_RewDiff <- lm(scaled_dACC_sal_RewDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_RewDiff + scaledArousal_RewDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_RewDiff, data = df.diff.rew)
model.dACCctrl.rating_RewDiff <- lm(scaled_dACC_ctrl_RewDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_RewDiff + scaledArousal_RewDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_RewDiff, data = df.diff.rew)
model.PFCl_sal.rating_RewDiff <- lm(scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_RewDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_RewDiff + scaledArousal_RewDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_RewDiff, data = df.diff.rew) 
model.PFCl_ctrl.rating_RewDiff <- lm(scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl_RewDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_RewDiff + scaledArousal_RewDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_RewDiff, data = df.diff.rew)
model.IFG.rating_RewDiff <- lm(scaled_Bilateral_IFG_RewDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_RewDiff + scaledArousal_RewDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_RewDiff, data = df.diff.rew)

tab_model(model.STR.rating_RewDiff, model.AI.rating_RewDiff, model.dACCsal.rating_RewDiff, model.dACCctrl.rating_RewDiff, model.PFCl_sal.rating_RewDiff, model.PFCl_ctrl.rating_RewDiff, model.IFG.rating_RewDiff,
          show.re.var = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE, show.icc = FALSE, show.ci = FALSE,
          dv.labels = c("Striatum", "AI", "dACCsal", "dACCctrl", "PFCl_sal", "PFCl_ctrl", "IFG"),
          title = "High - Low Reward Difference Models")

# Penalty Difference Models
model.STR.rating_PenDiff <- lm(scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_PenDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_PenDiff + scaledArousal_PenDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_PenDiff, data = df.diff.pen)
model.AI.rating_PenDiff <- lm(scaled_Bilateral_AI_PenDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_PenDiff + scaledArousal_PenDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_PenDiff, data = df.diff.pen)
model.dACCsal.rating_PenDiff <- lm(scaled_dACC_sal_PenDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_PenDiff + scaledArousal_PenDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_PenDiff, data = df.diff.pen)
model.dACCctrl.rating_PenDiff <- lm(scaled_dACC_ctrl_PenDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_PenDiff + scaledArousal_PenDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_PenDiff, data = df.diff.pen)
model.PFCl_sal.rating_PenDiff <- lm(scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_PenDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_PenDiff + scaledArousal_PenDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_PenDiff, data = df.diff.pen)
model.PFCl_ctrl.rating_PenDiff <- lm(scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl_PenDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_PenDiff + scaledArousal_PenDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_PenDiff, data = df.diff.pen) 
model.IFG.rating_PenDiff <- lm(scaled_Bilateral_IFG_PenDiff ~ scaledPleasantness_PenDiff + scaledArousal_PenDiff + scaledMeanMotivation_PenDiff, data = df.diff.pen)
```

# Cue-Related ROI actvity predicts control strategies for mental effort allocation  

## Reward and Penalty incentives guide dissociable strategies for control allocation
Correct Responses Per Second, Log RT, Accuracy
```{r}
# Response Rate model
model.accrt<-lmer(formula = Interval_norm_sum_Acc ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel * scaledIntervalCong +
                    scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + 
                    (1 + catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel| SubID),
                  data = df.interval, REML=FALSE,
                  lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))

# RT model
model.RT.trial<-lmer(formula = scaled_log10_AccRT ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel * Congruency +
                          scaledIntervalLength + scaledTrialSessionNum +
                          (1 + catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel | SubID),
                    data = df.trial, REML=FALSE,
                    lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))

# Accuracy model - Logit
model.acc.trial<-glmer(formula = Accuracy ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel * Congruency + 
                        scaledIntervalLength + scaledTrialSessionNum + 
                        (1 + catRewardLevel | SubID),
                      data = df.trial, family = binomial(link="logit"),
                      glmerControl(optimizer ='bobyqa'))

# Visualize the Response Rate, RT and Accuracy models
tab_model(model.accrt, model.RT.trial, model.acc.trial,
  show.re.var = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE, show.icc = FALSE, show.se = FALSE, show.ci = .95,
  p.style = "numeric_stars", p.threshold = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001), emph.p = TRUE,
  dv.labels = c("Response Rate", "Log RT","Accuracy"),
  pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Reward", "Penalty", "Interval Congruency", "Interval Length", "Interval Session Num", 
                  "Reward:Penalty", "Reward:Interval Congruency", "Penalty:Interval Congruency", "Rew:Pen:Interval Congruency",
                  "Trial Congruency", "Trial Session Num", "Reward:Trial Congruency", "Penalty:Trial Congruency", "Rew:Pen:Trial Congruency"),
  title = "Behavioral Task Performance by Incentive Condition")

# Stats for all Models
kable(anova(model.accrt), caption = "Response Rate") %>% kable_styling()  # Response Rate
kable(anova(model.RT.trial), caption = "Log RT") %>% kable_styling()      # Log RT
kable(anova(model.acc.trial), caption = "Accuracy") %>% kable_styling()   # Accuracy
```

## Drift Diffusion Model Posterior Estimates (Model 26)
### Model 36: Behavior
v \~ Reward + Penalty + Congruency \newline 
a \~ Reward + Penalty + scaledRunningTime
#### Read in Data
```{r}
# Model Name
model_str = "model36"

# Rhats
df.rhats<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_RHat.csv"), header = TRUE)
colnames(df.rhats) = c("parameter","Rhat")

# Traces
df.traces<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_traces.csv"))

# Traces Summary
df.traces.summary<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_Summary.csv"))
```

#### Extract and summarise model traces
```{r, message = FALSE}
# Select the traces for relevant group-level parameters. Note that threshold (a) needs to be divided by 2.
traces_group<-df.traces %>% dplyr::select(v_Intercept, 
                                    `v_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `v_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    `v_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                                    a_Intercept,
                                    `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `a_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    a_scaledRunningTime,
                                    `z_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                                    sv, st, t) %>%
  dplyr::rename(v_RewardLevel = `v_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                v_PenaltyLevel = `v_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                v_Congruency =`v_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                a_RewardLevel = `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                a_PenaltyLevel = `a_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                z_Congruency = `z_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`) %>%
  mutate(a_Intercept = 0.5*a_Intercept,
         a_RewardLevel = 0.5*a_RewardLevel,
         a_PenaltyLevel = 0.5*a_PenaltyLevel,
         a_scaledRunningTime = 0.5*a_scaledRunningTime,
         v_LowReward.LowPenalty = v_Intercept - v_RewardLevel - v_PenaltyLevel,
         v_HighReward.LowPenalty = v_Intercept + v_RewardLevel - v_PenaltyLevel,
         v_LowReward.HighPenalty = v_Intercept - v_RewardLevel + v_PenaltyLevel,
         v_HighReward.HighPenalty = v_Intercept + v_RewardLevel + v_PenaltyLevel,
         a_LowReward.LowPenalty = a_Intercept - a_RewardLevel - a_PenaltyLevel,
         a_HighReward.LowPenalty = a_Intercept + a_RewardLevel - a_PenaltyLevel,
         a_LowReward.HighPenalty = a_Intercept - a_RewardLevel + a_PenaltyLevel,
         a_HighReward.HighPenalty = a_Intercept + a_RewardLevel + a_PenaltyLevel)
View(traces_group)


traces_condition <- traces_group %>%
  select(v_LowReward.LowPenalty, v_HighReward.LowPenalty, v_LowReward.HighPenalty, v_HighReward.HighPenalty, 
        a_LowReward.LowPenalty, a_HighReward.LowPenalty, a_LowReward.HighPenalty, a_HighReward.HighPenalty) %>%
  map_dfr( ~ { 
    tibble(
      Mean = mean(.x), 
      SD = sd(.x), 
      CI_lower = quantile(.,.025), 
      CI_upper = quantile(.,.975)
      )
    }, .id = "parameter") %>%
  separate(col = parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter","condition")) %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("v","a"), labels = c("Drift Rate","Threshold"))) %>%
  separate(col = condition, sep = "\\.", into = c("Reward","Penalty")) %>%
  mutate(Reward = factor(Reward, levels = c("LowReward", "HighReward"), labels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward")),
        Penalty = factor(Penalty, levels = c("LowPenalty", "HighPenalty"), labels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty")))

traces_condition %>% 
  kable(digits = 4, caption = "Posterior Estimates by Incentive Condition") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Helvetica")
```

```{r}
# Simulation of Incentive Effects on Drift and Threshold
```

#### Plot the Posterior Estimates (Group)
```{r}
# Use test.params function to process trace info
output <- test.params(traces_group) %>% 
  slice(1:12)

# Format posterior parameters
all_params<-output %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("std",parameter)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(parameter = dplyr::recode(parameter, "sv" = "v_IntertrialVar", "st" = "t_IntertrialVar", "t" = "t_Intercept")) %>%
  separate(col = parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter","condition")) %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("a","v","z","t"), labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate","Bias","NDT")),
        condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","IntertrialVar","scaledRunningTime"),
                                      labels = c("Intercept","Reward","Penalty","Congruency","Intertrial Variability","Scaled Running Time")))

# Display table of posterior parameters
all_params %>% 
  kable(caption = "Drift Diffusion Model Posterior Estimates", digits = 3) %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Helvetica")

# Subset drift rate / threshold
drift.rate <- output %>%
	filter(parameter %in% c('v_Intercept','v_RewardLevel','v_PenaltyLevel','v_Congruency'))

threshold<- output %>%
	filter(parameter %in% c('a_Intercept','a_RewardLevel','a_PenaltyLevel','a_scaledRunningTime'))

va <- rbind(drift.rate,threshold) %>%
  separate(col = parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter","condition")) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","scaledRunningTime")),
         parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("a","v"), labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate")))

va.sub <- va %>% filter(! condition %in% c("Intercept","Congruency","scaledRunningTime"))

plot.parameters.va.int<-ggplot(data = va.sub, aes(x = condition, y = Mean, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_errorbar(width = .1, linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(width = .5), aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper)) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, x =condition, y = .12) ,position = position_dodge(.5), size = 8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.10,0.15)) + 
  #ggtitle(paste0(model_str," Parameter Estimates")) + 
  ylab("Parameter Estimate") + xlab("") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="", labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate"), values=colors.va2) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels= c("Reward","Penalty")) +
  ggposterior + 
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(.9,.2),
        )
plot.parameters.va.int

va.sub2 <- va %>% filter(condition != c("Intercept"))

plot.parameters.va.int2<-ggplot(data = va.sub2, aes(x = condition, y = Mean, fill = parameter)) +
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
# Extract the traces to plot
numSims = 5 # SET THIS PARAMETER BASED ON NUMBER OF SIMULATIONS
numTraces = dim(traces)[1]/numSims
index_traces = data.frame(ix1=1:5,ix2=(1:numSims)*numTraces)
index_traces$ix1[2:numSims] = index_traces$ix2[1:numSims-1]+1

# Extract traces for each simulation
plot_data1 = traces[index_traces[1,1]:index_traces[1,2]]
plot_data2 = traces[index_traces[2,1]:index_traces[2,2]]
plot_data3 = traces[index_traces[3,1]:index_traces[3,2]]
plot_data4 = traces[index_traces[4,1]:index_traces[4,2]]
plot_data5 = traces[index_traces[5,1]:index_traces[5,2]]

# For each parameter, plot the traces 
colNames=names(traces)
for (parameter in colNames) { # for testing: parameter=colNames[1]
  
  # plot traces
  traces_plot = ggplot(NULL) +
    geom_line(data=plot_data1, mapping = aes_string(y=parameter, x = 1:numTraces), colour="red") +         # Chain 1
    geom_line(data=plot_data2, mapping = aes_string(y=parameter, x = 1:numTraces), colour="royalblue1") +  # Chain 2
    geom_line(data=plot_data3, mapping = aes_string(y=parameter, x = 1:numTraces), colour="springgreen") + # Chain 3
    geom_line(data=plot_data4, mapping = aes_string(y=parameter, x = 1:numTraces), colour="grey0") +       # Chain 4
    geom_line(data=plot_data5, mapping = aes_string(y=parameter, x = 1:numTraces), colour="coral") +       # Chain 5
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    ggtitle(parameter) + 
    ylab("Parameter value") + xlab("Sample")
  
  plot_params <- ggplot(traces, aes_string(x = parameter)) +  
    geom_histogram(bins = 50) + 
    theme_classic()

  # print(traces_plot)
  mcmc_plot <- grid.arrange(traces_plot, plot_params)
  mcmc_plot

  # save trace plots
  ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/", model_str,"_traceplot_parameter_",parameter,".png"), plot = mcmc_plot, device = "png", width = 8, height = 6, scale = 1.1)

}
```

#### Generate 2D plots of drift rate and threshold
```{r}
TCB_traces=read.csv(paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/TCB_",model_str,"_traces_reshaped.csv"))

TCB_traces$v_LRLP = mean(TCB_traces$v_Intercept) - TCB_traces$v_C.RewardLevel..Sum..S.High.Reward. - TCB_traces$v_C.PenaltyLevel..Sum..S.High.Penalty.
TCB_traces$v_HRLP = mean(TCB_traces$v_Intercept) + TCB_traces$v_C.RewardLevel..Sum..S.High.Reward. - TCB_traces$v_C.PenaltyLevel..Sum..S.High.Penalty.
TCB_traces$v_LRHP = mean(TCB_traces$v_Intercept) - TCB_traces$v_C.RewardLevel..Sum..S.High.Reward. + TCB_traces$v_C.PenaltyLevel..Sum..S.High.Penalty.
TCB_traces$v_HRHP = mean(TCB_traces$v_Intercept) + TCB_traces$v_C.RewardLevel..Sum..S.High.Reward. + TCB_traces$v_C.PenaltyLevel..Sum..S.High.Penalty.

TCB_traces$a_LRLP = mean(TCB_traces$a_Intercept) - TCB_traces$a_C.RewardLevel..Sum..S.High.Reward. - TCB_traces$a_C.PenaltyLevel..Sum..S.High.Penalty.
TCB_traces$a_HRLP = mean(TCB_traces$a_Intercept) + TCB_traces$a_C.RewardLevel..Sum..S.High.Reward. - TCB_traces$a_C.PenaltyLevel..Sum..S.High.Penalty.
TCB_traces$a_LRHP = mean(TCB_traces$a_Intercept) - TCB_traces$a_C.RewardLevel..Sum..S.High.Reward. + TCB_traces$a_C.PenaltyLevel..Sum..S.High.Penalty.
TCB_traces$a_HRHP = mean(TCB_traces$a_Intercept) + TCB_traces$a_C.RewardLevel..Sum..S.High.Reward. + TCB_traces$a_C.PenaltyLevel..Sum..S.High.Penalty.

TCB_traces_plot = TCB_traces %>%
  dplyr::select(v_LRLP, v_HRLP, v_LRHP, v_HRHP, a_LRLP, a_HRLP, a_LRHP, a_HRHP) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),names_to = "param", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(param_name=substr(param,1,1),param_type=substr(param,3,nchar(param))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-param)%>%group_by(param_name,param_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean=mean(value), 
                  std=sd(value), 
                  median = quantile(value, 0.5), 
                  count=n(),
                  X2.5q=quantile(value,0.025),
                  X97.5q=quantile(value,0.975), 
                  se = std / sqrt(count)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = param_name,values_from = c(mean,std,median,X2.5q,X97.5q,se))

TCB_traces_plot$param_type=factor(TCB_traces_plot$param_type,levels = c("LRLP","LRHP","HRLP","HRHP"))

plot.2d<-ggplot(TCB_traces_plot,aes(x=mean_v,y=mean_a,color=param_type))+
        geom_point(size=4)+ 
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = X2.5q_a, ymax = X97.5q_a), width = 0) + 
        geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = X2.5q_v, xmax = X97.5q_v), height = 0)+
        ggtitle("TCBfMRI sample")+xlab("Drift Rate")+ylab("Threshold")+
        coord_cartesian(ylim=c(1.4,2.4), xlim = c(2.8,3.8)) + 
        theme(text = element_text(size=20))+
        geom_label(aes(x=mean_v, y=mean_a, label = c("  ", "  ", "  ", "  "), fill = param_type), size=2, color="black", nudge_x = 0.01, nudge_y = -0.015)+
        scale_fill_manual(values=c("#a1d99b", "#a1d99b","#31a354", "#31a354"))+
        scale_color_manual(values=c("#ff9999","#990000", "#ff9999","#990000"))+
        guides(fill="none", color="none")+theme_bw()+theme(text = element_text(size=20))
plot.2d

ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/", model_str,"_parameters_condition_2D.png"), plot = plot.2d, device = "png", width = 6, height = 6)
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/", model_str,"_parameters_condition_2D.eps"), plot = plot.2d, device = "eps", width = 6, height = 6)
ggsave(paste0(dir_name, "/outputs/plots/TCB/TCB_ddm_2D.png"), width = 6, height = 6, units = "in")
```

## Task Performance ~ Cue-Related and Interval-Related ROI Activity
### Task Performance ~ Ventral Striatum (Cue and Interval)
```{r}
# Run models
model.accrt.STR.cue<-lme4::lmer(formula = Interval_norm_sum_Acc ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_Striatum + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catRewardLevel + 
                              scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                            data = df.interval.cue, REML=FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.RT.trial.STR.cue<-lme4::lmer(formula = scaled_log10_AccRT ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_Striatum + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catRewardLevel + 
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                            data = df.trial.cue, REML=FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.acc.trial.STR.cue<-glmer(formula = Accuracy ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_Striatum + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catRewardLevel + 
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID),
                            data = df.trial.cue, family = binomial(link="logit"), glmerControl(optimizer ='bobyqa'))
model.accrt.STR.int<-lme4::lmer(formula = Interval_norm_sum_Acc ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_Striatum + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catRewardLevel + 
                              scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                            data = df.interval.int, REML=FALSE,
                            lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.RT.trial.STR.int<-lme4::lmer(formula = scaled_log10_AccRT ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_Striatum + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catRewardLevel + 
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                              data = df.trial.int, REML=FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.acc.trial.STR.int<-glmer(formula = Accuracy ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_Striatum + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_Striatum:catRewardLevel + 
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID),
                            data = df.trial.int, family = binomial(link="logit"), glmerControl(optimizer ='bobyqa'))

          title = "Task Performance Predicted by Ventral Striatum (Cue)",

          pred.labels = c("(Intercept)","Reward","Penalty","Ventral Striatum (VS)","Interval Congruency",
          "Interval Length","Interval Session Number","Reward:Penalty","VS:Penalty","VS:Reward","Congruency"))

tab_model(model.accrt.STR.int, model.RT.trial.STR.int, model.acc.trial.STR.int,
```

```{r}
# Run models

                              scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID),
```

```{r}
# Run models
model.accrt.dACCctrl.cue<-lme4::lmer(formula = Interval_norm_sum_Acc ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_dACC_ctrl + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catRewardLevel +
                              scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                            data = df.interval.cue, REML=FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.RT.trial.dACCctrl.cue<-lme4::lmer(formula = scaled_log10_AccRT ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_dACC_ctrl + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catRewardLevel +
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                            data = df.trial.cue, REML=FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.acc.trial.dACCctrl.cue<-glmer(formula = Accuracy ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_dACC_ctrl + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catRewardLevel +
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID),
                            data = df.trial.cue, family = binomial(link="logit"), glmerControl(optimizer ='bobyqa'))
model.accrt.dACCctrl.int<-lme4::lmer(formula = Interval_norm_sum_Acc ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_dACC_ctrl + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catRewardLevel +
                              scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                            data = df.interval.int, REML=FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.RT.trial.dACCctrl.int<-lme4::lmer(formula = scaled_log10_AccRT ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_dACC_ctrl + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catRewardLevel +
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                            data = df.trial.int, REML=FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.acc.trial.dACCctrl.int<-glmer(formula = Accuracy ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_dACC_ctrl + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_dACC_ctrl:catRewardLevel +
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID),
                            data = df.trial.int, family = binomial(link="logit"), glmerControl(optimizer ='bobyqa'))
```

### Task Performance ~ Inferior Frontal Gyrus (Cue and Interval)
```{r}
# Run models
model.accrt.IFG.cue<-lme4::lmer(formula = Interval_norm_sum_Acc ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_IFG + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catRewardLevel +
                              scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                            data = df.interval.cue, REML=FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.RT.trial.IFG.cue<-lme4::lmer(formula = scaled_log10_AccRT ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_IFG + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catRewardLevel +
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                            data = df.trial.cue, REML=FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.acc.trial.IFG.cue<-glmer(formula = Accuracy ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_IFG + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catRewardLevel +
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID),
                            data = df.trial.cue, family = binomial(link="logit"), glmerControl(optimizer ='bobyqa'))
model.accrt.IFG.int<-lme4::lmer(formula = Interval_norm_sum_Acc ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_IFG + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catRewardLevel +
                              scaledIntervalCong + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                            data = df.interval.int, REML=FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.RT.trial.IFG.int<-lme4::lmer(formula = scaled_log10_AccRT ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_IFG + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catRewardLevel +
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID), 
                            data = df.trial.int, REML=FALSE, lmerControl(optimizer ='optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')))
model.acc.trial.IFG.int<-glmer(formula = Accuracy ~ catRewardLevel * catPenaltyLevel +
                              scaled_Bilateral_IFG + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catPenaltyLevel + scaled_Bilateral_IFG:catRewardLevel +
                              Congruency + scaledIntervalLength + scaledIntervalSessionNum + (1 | SubID),
                            data = df.trial.int, family = binomial(link="logit"), glmerControl(optimizer ='bobyqa'))
```
