## Model Based fMRI (DDM + Neural Regressors)
### Ventral Striatum Cue (Model 37)
#### Read in Data
```{r}
# Model Name
model_str = "model37"
ROI = "VS"
phase = "Cue"

# Rhats
df.rhats<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_RHat.csv"), header = TRUE)
colnames(df.rhats) = c("parameter","Rhat")

# Traces
df.traces<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_traces.csv"))

# Traces Summary
df.traces.summary<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_Summary.csv"))

# Select the traces for relevant group-level parameters. Note that threshold (a) needs to be divided by 2.
traces<-df.traces %>% dplyr::select(v_Intercept, 
                                    `v_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `v_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    `v_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                                    v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue,
                                    v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue_std,
                                    `v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                                    `v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    `v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                                    a_Intercept,
                                    `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                                    `a_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue,
																		a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue_std,
                                    `a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                                    `a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    `a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                                    a_scaledRunningTime,
                                    `z_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                                    sv, st, t) %>%
  dplyr::rename(v_RewardLevel = `v_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                v_PenaltyLevel = `v_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                v_Congruency =`v_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                v_Striatum = v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue,
                v_Striatumstd = v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue_std,
                v_StriatumRew = `v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                v_StriatumRewstd = `v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                v_StriatumPen = `v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                v_StriatumPenstd = `v_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                a_RewardLevel = `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                a_RewardLevelstd = `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                a_PenaltyLevel = `a_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                a_Striatum = a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue,
								a_Striatumstd = a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue_std,
                a_StriatumRew = `a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                a_StriatumRewstd = `a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                a_StriatumPen = `a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                a_StriatumPenstd = `a_scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                z_Congruency = `z_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`) %>%
  mutate(a_Intercept = 0.5*a_Intercept,
         a_RewardLevel = 0.5*a_RewardLevel,
         a_PenaltyLevel = 0.5*a_PenaltyLevel,
         a_Striatum = 0.5*a_Striatum,
         a_StriatumRew = 0.5*a_StriatumRew,
         a_StriatumPen = 0.5*a_StriatumPen,
         a_scaledRunningTime = 0.5*a_scaledRunningTime)
#View(traces)
```
#### Plot the Posterior Estimates
```{r}
# Use test.params function to process trace info
output <- test.params(traces)

# Format posterior parameters
all_params<-output %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("std",parameter)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(parameter = dplyr::recode(parameter, "sv" = "v_IntertrialVar", "st" = "t_IntertrialVar", "t" = "t_Intercept")) %>%
  separate(col = parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter","condition")) %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("a","v","z","t"), labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate","Bias","NDT")),
          condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","IntertrialVar","scaledRunningTime","Striatum","StriatumRew","StriatumPen"),
                                        labels = c("Intercept","Reward","Penalty","Congruency","Intertrial Variability","Scaled Running Time","Striatum","Striatum x Reward", "Striatum x Penalty")))

# Display table of posterior parameters
all_params %>% 
  kable(caption = "Drift Diffusion Model with Ventral Striatum (Cue) Posterior Estimates", digits = 3) %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Helvetica")

# Subset drift rate / threshold
drift.rate <- output %>% 
  filter(parameter %in% c('v_Intercept','v_RewardLevel','v_PenaltyLevel','v_Congruency','v_Striatum','v_StriatumRew','v_StriatumPen'))

threshold<- output %>% 
  filter(parameter %in% c('a_Intercept','a_RewardLevel','a_PenaltyLevel','a_scaledRunningTime','a_Striatum','a_StriatumRew','a_StriatumPen'))

va.VS.cue <- rbind(drift.rate,threshold) %>%
  separate(col = parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter","condition")) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","scaledRunningTime","Striatum","StriatumRew","StriatumPen"),
                                        labels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","scaledRunningTime","VS","VS x Reward","VS x Penalty")),
         parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("a","v"), labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate")))

va_sub <- va.VS.cue %>% filter(! condition %in% c("Intercept","Congruency","scaledRunningTime"))
plot_labels = c("Reward","Penalty",ROI,paste0(ROI," x Reward"),paste0(ROI," x Penalty"))
plot.parameters.va<-ggplot(data = va_sub, aes(x = condition, y = Mean, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_errorbar(width = .1, linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(width = .5), aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper)) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, x =condition, y = .12) ,position = position_dodge(.5), size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.10,0.15)) + 
  #ggtitle(paste0(model_str," Parameter Estimates")) + 
  ylab("Parameter Estimate") + xlab("") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="", labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate"), values=colors.va2) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels= plot_labels) +
  ggposterior + 
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(.9,.2))
plot.parameters.va

# Save figure of posteriors
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/", model_str,"_",ROI,"_",phase,"_posteriors.png"), 
  plot = plot.parameters.va, device = "png", width = 9, height = 6, scale = 1)
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/", model_str,"_",ROI,"_",phase,"_posteriors.eps"), 
  plot = plot.parameters.va, device = "eps", width = 9, height = 6, scale = 1)
```

### Anterior Insula Interval (Model 47))
#### Read in Data
```{r}
# Model Name
model_str = "model47"
ROI = "AI"
phase = "Interval"

# Rhats
df.rhats<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_RHat.csv"), header = TRUE)
colnames(df.rhats) = c("parameter","Rhat")

# Traces
df.traces<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_traces.csv"))

# Traces Summary
df.traces.summary<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_Summary.csv"))

# Select the traces for relevant group-level parameters. Note that threshold (a) needs to be divided by 2.
traces<-df.traces %>% dplyr::select(v_Intercept, 
                                    `v_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `v_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    `v_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                                    v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval,
                                    v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval_std,
                                    `v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                                    `v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    `v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                                    a_Intercept,
                                    `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `a_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval,
                                    a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval_std,
                                    `a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                                    `a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    `a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                                    a_scaledRunningTime,
                                    `z_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                                    sv, st, t) %>%
  dplyr::rename(v_RewardLevel = `v_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                v_PenaltyLevel = `v_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                v_Congruency =`v_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                v_AI = v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval,
                v_AIstd = v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval_std,
                v_AIRew = `v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                v_AIRewstd = `v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                v_AIPen = `v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                v_AIPenstd = `v_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                a_RewardLevel = `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                a_PenaltyLevel = `a_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                a_AI = a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval,
                a_AIstd = a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval_std,
                a_AIRew = `a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                a_AIRewstd = `a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                a_AIPen = `a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                a_AIPenstd = `a_scaled_Bilateral_AI_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                z_Congruency = `z_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`) %>%
  mutate(a_Intercept = 0.5*a_Intercept,
         a_RewardLevel = 0.5*a_RewardLevel,
         a_PenaltyLevel = 0.5*a_PenaltyLevel,
         a_AI = 0.5*a_AI,
         a_AIRew = 0.5*a_AIRew,
         a_AIPen = 0.5*a_AIPen,
         a_scaledRunningTime = 0.5*a_scaledRunningTime)
```

#### Plot the Posterior Estimates
```{r}
# Use test.params function to process trace info
output <- test.params(traces)

# Format posterior parameters
all_params<-output %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("std",parameter)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(parameter = dplyr::recode(parameter, "sv" = "v_IntertrialVar", "st" = "t_IntertrialVar", "t" = "t_Intercept")) %>%
  separate(col = parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter","condition")) %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("a","v","z","t"), labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate","Bias","NDT")),
          condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","IntertrialVar","scaledRunningTime","AI","AIRew","AIPen"),
                                        labels = c("Intercept","Reward","Penalty","Congruency","Intertrial Variability","Scaled Running Time","AI","AI x Reward", "AI x Penalty")))

# Display table of posterior parameters
all_params %>% 
  kable(caption = "Drift Diffusion Model with Anterior Insula (Interval) Posterior Estimates", digits = 3) %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Helvetica")

# Subset drift rate / threshold
drift.rate <- output %>% 
  filter(parameter %in% c('v_Intercept','v_RewardLevel','v_PenaltyLevel','v_Congruency','v_AI','v_AIRew','v_AIPen'))

threshold<- output %>% 
  filter(parameter %in% c('a_Intercept','a_RewardLevel','a_PenaltyLevel','a_scaledRunningTime','a_AI','a_AIRew','a_AIPen'))

va.AI.int <- rbind(drift.rate,threshold) %>%
  separate(col = parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter","condition")) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","scaledRunningTime","AI","AIRew","AIPen"),
                                       labels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","scaledRunningTime","AI","AI x Reward","AI x Penalty")),
         parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("a","v"), labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate")))

va_sub <- va.AI.int %>% filter(! condition %in% c("Intercept","Congruency","scaledRunningTime"))
plot_labels = c("Reward","Penalty",ROI,paste0(ROI," x Reward"),paste0(ROI," x Penalty"))
plot.parameters.va<-ggplot(data = va_sub, aes(x = condition, y = Mean, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_errorbar(width = .1, linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(width = .5), aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper)) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, x =condition, y = .20) ,position = position_dodge(.5), size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.35,0.25)) + 
  #ggtitle(paste0(model_str," Parameter Estimates")) + 
  ylab("Parameter Estimate") + xlab("") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="", labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate"), values=colors.va2) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels= plot_labels) +
  ggposterior + 
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(.9,.2))
plot.parameters.va

# Save figure of posteriors
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/", model_str,"_",ROI,"_",phase,"_posteriors.png"),
```

### Rostral dACC (dACC-ctrl) Cue (Model 39)
#### Read in Data
```{r}
# Model Name
model_str = "model39"
ROI = "dACCctrl"
phase = "Cue"

# Rhats
df.rhats<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_RHat.csv"), header = TRUE)
colnames(df.rhats) = c("parameter","Rhat")

# Traces
df.traces<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_traces.csv"))

# Traces Summary
df.traces.summary<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_Summary.csv"))

# Select the traces for relevant group-level parameters. Note that threshold (a) needs to be divided by 2.
traces<-df.traces %>% dplyr::select(v_Intercept, 
                                    `v_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `v_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    `v_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                                    v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue,
																		v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue_std,
                                    `v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
																		`v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                                    `v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
																		`v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                                    a_Intercept,
                                    `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `a_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue,
																		a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue_std,
                                    `a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
																		`a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                                    `a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
																		`a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                                    a_scaledRunningTime,
                                    `z_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                                    sv, st, t) %>%
  dplyr::rename(v_RewardLevel = `v_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                v_PenaltyLevel = `v_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                v_Congruency =`v_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                v_dACCctrl = v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue,
								v_dACCctrlstd = v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue_std,
                v_dACCctrlRew = `v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
								v_dACCctrlRewstd = `v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                v_dACCctrlPen = `v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
								v_dACCctrlPenstd = `v_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                a_RewardLevel = `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                a_PenaltyLevel = `a_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                a_dACCctrl = a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue,
								a_dACCctrlstd = a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue_std,
                a_dACCctrlRew = `a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
								a_dACCctrlRewstd = `a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                a_dACCctrlPen = `a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
								a_dACCctrlPenstd = `a_scaled_dACC_ctrl_cue:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                z_Congruency = `z_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`) %>%
  mutate(a_Intercept = 0.5*a_Intercept,
         a_RewardLevel = 0.5*a_RewardLevel,
         a_PenaltyLevel = 0.5*a_PenaltyLevel,
         a_dACCctrl = 0.5*a_dACCctrl,
         a_dACCctrlRew = 0.5*a_dACCctrlRew,
         a_dACCctrlPen = 0.5*a_dACCctrlPen,
         a_scaledRunningTime = 0.5*a_scaledRunningTime)
```
#### Plot the Posterior Estimates
```{r}
# Use test.params function to process trace info
output <- test.params(traces)

# Format posterior parameters
all_params<-output %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("std",parameter)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(parameter = dplyr::recode(parameter, "sv" = "v_IntertrialVar", "st" = "t_IntertrialVar", "t" = "t_Intercept")) %>%
  separate(col = parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter","condition")) %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("a","v","z","t"), labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate","Bias","NDT")),
          condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","IntertrialVar","scaledRunningTime","dACCctrl","dACCctrlRew","dACCctrlPen"),
                                        labels = c("Intercept","Reward","Penalty","Congruency","Intertrial Variability","Scaled Running Time","Rostral dACC","Rostral dACC x Reward", "Rostral dACC x Penalty")))

# Display table of posterior parameters
all_params %>% 
  kable(caption = "Drift Diffusion Model with Rostral dACC (Cue) Posterior Estimates", digits = 3) %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Helvetica")

# Subset drift rate / threshold
drift.rate <- output %>% 
  filter(parameter %in% c('v_Intercept','v_RewardLevel','v_PenaltyLevel','v_Congruency','v_dACCctrl','v_dACCctrlRew','v_dACCctrlPen'))

threshold<- output %>% 
  filter(parameter %in% c('a_Intercept','a_RewardLevel','a_PenaltyLevel','a_scaledRunningTime','a_dACCctrl','a_dACCctrlRew','a_dACCctrlPen'))

va.dACCctrl.cue <- rbind(drift.rate,threshold) %>%
  separate(col = parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter","condition")) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","scaledRunningTime","dACCctrl","dACCctrlRew","dACCctrlPen"),
                                        labels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","scaledRunningTime","dACCctrl","dACCctrl x Reward","dACCctrl x Penalty")),
         parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("a","v"), labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate")))

va_sub <- va.dACCctrl.cue %>% filter(! condition %in% c("Intercept","Congruency","scaledRunningTime"))
plot_labels = c("Reward","Penalty",ROI,paste0(ROI," x Reward"),paste0(ROI," x Penalty"))
plot.parameters.va<-ggplot(data = va_sub, aes(x = condition, y = Mean, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_errorbar(width = .1, linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(width = .5), aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper)) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, x =condition, y = .10) ,position = position_dodge(.5), size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.10,0.12)) + 
  #ggtitle(paste0(model_str," Parameter Estimates")) + 
  ylab("Parameter Estimate") + xlab("") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="", labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate"), values=colors.va2) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels= plot_labels) +
  ggposterior + 
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(.9,.2))
plot.parameters.va

# Save figure of posteriors
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/", model_str,"_",ROI,"_",phase,"_posteriors.png"), 
  plot = plot.parameters.va, device = "png", width = 9, height = 6, scale = 1)
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/", model_str,"_",ROI,"_",phase,"_posteriors.eps"),
```

```{r}
va.DLPFC.cue <- rbind(drift.rate,threshold) %>%
  separate(col = parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter","condition")) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","scaledRunningTime","PFCls","PFClsRew","PFClsPen"),
                                        labels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","scaledRunningTime","DLPFC","DLPFC x Reward","DLPFC x Penalty")),
         parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("a","v"), labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate")))

plot_labels = c("Reward","Penalty",ROI,paste0(ROI," x Reward"),paste0(ROI," x Penalty"))
plot.parameters.va<-ggplot(data = va_sub, aes(x = condition, y = Mean, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_errorbar(width = .1, linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(width = .5), aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper)) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, x =condition, y = .10) ,position = position_dodge(.5), size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.10,0.12)) + 
  #ggtitle(paste0(model_str," Parameter Estimates")) + 
  ylab("Parameter Estimate") + xlab("") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="", labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate"), values=colors.va2) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels= plot_labels) +
  ggposterior + 
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(.9,.2))
plot.parameters.va

# Save figure of posteriors

  plot = plot.parameters.va, device = "png", width = 9, height = 6, scale = 1)
```

```{r}
                                    `v_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
																		`v_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                                    a_Intercept,
                                    `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                                    `a_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                                    a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval,
																		a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval_std,
                                    `a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
																		`a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                                    `a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
																		`a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                                    a_scaledRunningTime,
                                    `z_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                                    sv, st, t) %>%
  dplyr::rename(v_RewardLevel = `v_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                v_PenaltyLevel = `v_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                v_Congruency =`v_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`,
                v_PFCls = v_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval,
								v_PFClsstd = v_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval_std,
                v_PFClsRew = `v_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
								v_PFClsRewstd = `v_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                v_PFClsPen = `v_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
								v_PFClsPenstd = `v_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                a_RewardLevel = `a_C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
                a_PenaltyLevel = `a_C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
                a_PFCls = a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval,
								a_PFClsstd = a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval_std,
                a_PFClsRew = `a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]`,
								a_PFClsRewstd = `a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(RewardLevel, Sum)[S.High Reward]_std`,
                a_PFClsPen = `a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]`,
								a_PFClsPenstd = `a_scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_interval:C(PenaltyLevel, Sum)[S.High Penalty]_std`,
                z_Congruency = `z_C(Congruency, Sum)[S.Congruent]`) %>%

         a_RewardLevel =0.5*a_RewardLevel,
         a_PenaltyLevel = 0.5*a_PenaltyLevel,

         a_PFClsPen = 0.5*a_PFClsPen,
         a_scaledRunningTime = 0.5*a_scaledRunningTime)
```

```{r}
  filter(parameter %in% c('v_Intercept','v_RewardLevel','v_PenaltyLevel','v_Congruency','v_IFG','v_IFGRew','v_IFGPen'))

threshold<- output %>% 
  filter(parameter %in% c('a_Intercept','a_RewardLevel','a_PenaltyLevel','a_scaledRunningTime','a_IFG','a_IFGRew','a_IFGPen'))

va.IFG.int <- rbind(drift.rate,threshold) %>%
  separate(col = parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter","condition")) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","scaledRunningTime","IFG","IFGRew","IFGPen"),
                                        labels = c("Intercept", "RewardLevel","PenaltyLevel","Congruency","scaledRunningTime","IFG","IFG x Reward","IFG x Penalty")),
         parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("a","v"), labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate")))

va_sub <- va.IFG.int %>% filter(! condition %in% c("Intercept","Congruency","scaledRunningTime"))
plot_labels = c("Reward","Penalty",ROI,paste0(ROI," x Reward"),paste0(ROI," x Penalty"))
plot.parameters.va<-ggplot(data = va_sub, aes(x = condition, y = Mean, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_errorbar(width = .1, linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(width = .5), aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper)) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, x =condition, y = .39) ,position = position_dodge(.5), size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.30,0.40)) + 
  #ggtitle(paste0(model_str," Parameter Estimates")) + 
  ylab("Parameter Estimate") + xlab("") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="", labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate"), values=colors.va2) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels= plot_labels) +
  ggposterior + 
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(.9,.2))
plot.parameters.va

# Save figure of posteriors
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/", model_str,"_",ROI,"_",phase,"_posteriors.png"), 
  plot = plot.parameters.va, device = "png", width = 9, height = 6, scale = 1)
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/", model_str,"_",ROI,"_",phase,"_posteriors.eps"), 
  plot = plot.parameters.va, device = "eps", width = 9, height = 6, scale = 1)
```

```{r}
va.dACCctrl.cue.sub <- va.dACCctrl.cue %>% filter(str_detect(condition,"dACCctrl") & (str_detect(condition, "Reward") | str_detect(condition, "Penalty"))) %>%

va.DLPFC.cue.sub <- va.DLPFC.cue %>% filter(str_detect(condition,"DLPFC") & (str_detect(condition, "Reward") | str_detect(condition, "Penalty"))) %>%

va.IFG.cue.sub <- va.IFG.cue %>% filter(str_detect(condition,"IFG") & (str_detect(condition, "Reward") | str_detect(condition, "Penalty"))) %>%
```

```{r}
        ROI2 = factor(ROI, levels = c("IFG","DLPFC","dACCctrl","dACCsal","AI","VS"), labels = c("IFG","DLPFC","dACCctrl","dACCsal","AI","VS")),
        incentive = factor(incentive, levels = c("Reward","Penalty"), labels = c("Reward","Penalty")),
```

```{r}
# Subset the main effects
va.VS.int.sub <- va.VS.int %>% filter(str_detect(condition,"VS") & (str_detect(condition, "Reward") | str_detect(condition, "Penalty"))) %>% 
  mutate(incentive = c("Reward","Penalty","Reward","Penalty"), ROI = "VS")
va.AI.int.sub <- va.AI.int %>% filter(str_detect(condition,"AI") & (str_detect(condition, "Reward") | str_detect(condition, "Penalty"))) %>% 
  mutate(incentive = c("Reward","Penalty","Reward","Penalty"), ROI = "AI")
va.dACCsal.int.sub <- va.dACCsal.int %>% filter(str_detect(condition,"dACCsal") & (str_detect(condition, "Reward") | str_detect(condition, "Penalty"))) %>% 
  mutate(incentive = c("Reward","Penalty","Reward","Penalty"), ROI = "dACCsal")
va.dACCctrl.int.sub <- va.dACCctrl.int %>% filter(str_detect(condition,"dACCctrl") & (str_detect(condition, "Reward") | str_detect(condition, "Penalty"))) %>% 
  mutate(incentive = c("Reward","Penalty","Reward","Penalty"), ROI = "dACCctrl")
va.DLPFC.int.sub <- va.DLPFC.int %>% filter(str_detect(condition,"DLPFC") & (str_detect(condition, "Reward") | str_detect(condition, "Penalty"))) %>% 
  mutate(incentive = c("Reward","Penalty","Reward","Penalty"), ROI = "DLPFC")
va.IFG.int.sub <- va.IFG.int %>% filter(str_detect(condition,"IFG") & (str_detect(condition, "Reward") | str_detect(condition, "Penalty"))) %>% 
  mutate(incentive = c("Reward","Penalty","Reward","Penalty"), ROI = "IFG")

va_ROIs.int <- bind_rows(va.VS.int.sub,
                        va.AI.int.sub,
                        va.dACCsal.int.sub,
                        va.dACCctrl.int.sub,
                        va.DLPFC.int.sub,
                        va.IFG.int.sub) %>%
  mutate(ROI = factor(ROI, levels = c("VS","AI","dACCsal","dACCctrl","DLPFC","IFG"), labels = c("VS","AI","dACCsal","dACCctrl","DLPFC","IFG")),
        ROI2 = factor(ROI, levels = c("IFG","DLPFC","dACCctrl","dACCsal","AI","VS"), labels = c("IFG","DLPFC","dACCctrl","dACCsal","AI","VS")),
        incentive = factor(incentive, levels = c("Reward","Penalty"), labels = c("Reward","Penalty")),
        parameter2 = factor(parameter, levels = c("Drift Rate","Threshold"), labels = c("Drift Rate","Threshold")))
View(va_ROIs.int)


# Plot ROI interval effects
plot_labels = c("VS","AI","Caudal dACC", "Rostral dACC","DLPFC","IFG")
plot.parameters.va<-ggplot(data = va_ROIs.int, aes(x = ROI, y = Mean, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_errorbar(width = .1, linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(width = .5), aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper)) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, x = ROI, y = .) ,position = position_dodge(.5), size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) + 
  facet_grid(incentive~., scales = "free_y") + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.03,0.10)) + 
  #ggtitle(paste0(model_str," Parameter Estimates")) + 
  ylab("Parameter Estimate") + xlab("") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="", labels = c("Threshold","Drift Rate"), values=colors.va2) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels= plot_labels) +
  ggposterior + 
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(.15,.95),
        axis.line = element_line())
plot.parameters.va

# Forest Plot
plot.parameters.va_forest<-ggplot(data = va_ROIs.int, aes(x = Mean, y = ROI2, color = incentive)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_point(shape = 19, position = position_dodge(-.3), size = 8) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper), position = position_dodge(-.3), height = 0.2, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, y = ROI), position = position_dodge(-.05), size = 8, color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) + 
  facet_grid(.~parameter2, scales = "free_x") + 
  #coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.03,0.10)) + 
  #ggtitle(paste0(model_str," Parameter Estimates")) + 
  ylab("") + xlab("Parameter Estimate") + 
  scale_color_manual(name="", labels = c("Reward","Penalty"), values=colors.redgreen2) +
  ggposterior + 
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(.9,.15),
        axis.line = element_line(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 24),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
```

```{r}
              values_from = c(scaledMeanMotivation, 
                              scaledMotivation,
                              scaledEffort, 
                              scaledAttention, 
                              scaledDifficult, 
                              scaledPleasantness, 
                              scaledArousal, 
                              PosArousal,
                              NegArousal,
                              scale_Interval_log10_AccRT, 
                              Interval_log10_AccRT,
                              Interval_Acc,
                              scaled_Bilateral_Striatum, 
                              scaled_Bilateral_AI,
                              scaled_dACC_sal,
                              scaled_dACC_ctrl,
                              scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal,
                              scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl,
                              scaled_Bilateral_IFG)) %>%
  mutate(scaledMeanMotivation_RewDiff = scaledMeanMotivation_High - scaledMeanMotivation_Low,
        scaledMotivation_RewDiff = scaledMotivation_High - scaledMotivation_Low,
        scaledEffort_RewDiff = scaledEffort_High - scaledEffort_Low,
        scaledAttention_RewDiff = scaledAttention_High - scaledAttention_Low,
        scaledDifficult_RewDiff = scaledDifficult_High - scaledDifficult_Low,
        scaledPleasantness_RewDiff = scaledPleasantness_High - scaledPleasantness_Low,
        scaledArousal_RewDiff= scaledArousal_High - scaledArousal_Low,
        PosArousal_RewDiff = PosArousal_High - PosArousal_Low,
        NegArousal_RewDiff = NegArousal_High - NegArousal_Low,
        scale_Interval_log10_AccRT_RewDiff = scale_Interval_log10_AccRT_High - scale_Interval_log10_AccRT_Low,
        Interval_log10_AccRT_RewDiff = Interval_log10_AccRT_High - Interval_log10_AccRT_Low,
        Interval_Acc_RewDiff = Interval_Acc_High - Interval_Acc_Low,
        scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_RewDiff = scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_High - scaled_Bilateral_Striatum_Low, 
        scaled_Bilateral_AI_RewDiff = scaled_Bilateral_AI_High - scaled_Bilateral_AI_Low,
        scaled_dACC_sal_RewDiff = scaled_dACC_sal_High - scaled_dACC_sal_Low,
        scaled_dACC_ctrl_RewDiff = scaled_dACC_ctrl_High - scaled_dACC_ctrl_Low,
        scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_RewDiff = scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_High - scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_sal_Low,
        scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl_RewDiff = scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl_High - scaled_Bilateral_PFCl_ctrl_Low,
        scaled_Bilateral_IFG_RewDiff = scaled_Bilateral_IFG_High - scaled_Bilateral_IFG_Low)
```

## Correlation Matrix of Difference Scores, Control Strategies, Beta Estimates

### Subjective Motivation Ratings and DDM (Model 36)
```{r}
# DDM Behavior Only (Model 36)
model_str = "model36"
# Traces Summary
df.traces.summary<-fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_Summary.csv"))

# drift rate - reward effect
traces.v.reward <- df.traces.summary %>%
  filter(str_detect(V1,"v_C\\(RewardLevel, Sum\\)\\[S\\.High Reward\\]_subj")) %>%
  tidyr::extract(V1, into = c("condition","SubID"), regex = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
  #tidyr::extract(condition, into = c("parameter","condition"), regex = "([^_]+)_(.*)") %>% 
  mutate(condition = "v_RewardLevel") %>%
  dplyr::rename(mean_v_RewardLevel = mean, std_v_RewardLevel = std) 
traces.v.penalty <- df.traces.summary %>%
  filter(str_detect(V1,"v_C\\(PenaltyLevel, Sum\\)\\[S\\.High Penalty\\]_subj")) %>%
  tidyr::extract(V1, into = c("condition","SubID"), regex = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
  #tidyr::extract(condition, into = c("parameter","condition"), regex = "([^_]+)_(.*)") %>% 
  mutate(condition = "v_PenaltyLevel") %>%
  dplyr::rename(mean_v_PenaltyLevel = mean, std_v_PenaltyLevel = std)
traces.v.intercept <- df.traces.summary %>%
  filter(str_detect(V1,"v_Intercept_subj")) %>%
  tidyr::extract(V1, into = c("condition","SubID"), regex = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
  #tidyr::extract(condition, into = c("parameter","condition"), regex = "([^_]+)_(.*)") %>% 
  mutate(condition = "v_Intercept") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(mean_v_Intercept = mean, std_v_Intercept = std)
traces.a.reward <- df.traces.summary %>%
  filter(str_detect(V1,"a_C\\(RewardLevel, Sum\\)\\[S\\.High Reward\\]_subj")) %>%
  tidyr::extract(V1, into = c("condition","SubID"), regex = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
  #tidyr::extract(condition, into = c("parameter","condition"), regex = "([^_]+)_(.*)") %>% 
  mutate(condition = "a_RewardLevel") %>%
  dplyr::rename(mean_a_RewardLevel = mean, std_a_RewardLevel = std)
traces.a.penalty <- df.traces.summary %>%
  filter(str_detect(V1,"a_C\\(PenaltyLevel, Sum\\)\\[S\\.High Penalty\\]_subj")) %>%
  tidyr::extract(V1, into = c("condition","SubID"), regex = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
  #tidyr::extract(condition, into = c("parameter","condition"), regex = "([^_]+)_(.*)") %>% 
  mutate(condition = "a_PenaltyLevel")  %>%
  dplyr::rename(mean_a_PenaltyLevel = mean, std_a_PenaltyLevel = std)
traces.a.intercept <- df.traces.summary %>%
  filter(str_detect(V1,"a_Intercept_subj")) %>%
  tidyr::extract(V1, into = c("condition","SubID"), regex = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
  #tidyr::extract(condition, into = c("parameter","condition"), regex = "([^_]+)_(.*)") %>% 
  mutate(condition = "a_Intercept")  %>%
  dplyr::rename(mean_a_Intercept = mean, std_a_Intercept = std)

# View(traces.v.reward)
# View(traces.v.penalty)
# View(traces.v.intercept)
# View(traces.a.reward)
# View(traces.a.penalty)
# View(traces.a.intercept)

# Rhat and Phat Values from model 36
rp_hat = fread(input = paste0(datapath.ddm,model_str,"/",model_str,"_RPhats.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(SubID = str_extract(SubID, "\\d+")) %>%
  mutate(R_LR = as.numeric(R_LR), R_HR = as.numeric(R_HR), P_LP = as.numeric(P_LP), P_HP = as.numeric(P_HP)) %>%
  mutate(logR_LR=log10(R_LR), logR_HR=log10(R_HR),logP_LP=log10(P_LP), logP_HP=log10(P_HP))%>%
  mutate(logR_mean = (logR_LR+logR_HR)/2, logP_mean = (logP_LP+logP_HP)/2,
         logR_contrast = logR_HR-logR_LR, logP_contrast = logP_HP-logP_LP,
         logR_contrast_abs = abs(logR_contrast), logP_contrast_abs = abs(logP_contrast)) 

# Ziwei Code
# rp_hat = read.csv(paste0(basepath, "/model1_RewPen_collector_RPHat.csv"))%>%
# mutate(logR_LR=log10(R_LR), logR_HR=log10(R_HR),logP_LP=log10(P_LP), logP_HP=log10(P_HP))%>%
# mutate(logR_mean = (logR_LR+logR_HR)/2, logP_mean = (logP_LP+logP_HP)/2,
#   logR_contrast = logR_HR-logR_LR, logP_contrast = logP_HP-logP_LP,
#   logR_contrast_abs = abs(logR_contrast), logP_contrast_abs = abs(logP_contrast))%>%full_join(subj, by=c("SubID" = "subj_idx"))


# Correlation Matrix of Self-Report and DDM parameters 
df.diff.combined <- df.diff.rew.cue %>%
  select(SubID, scaledMeanMotivation_RewDiff, scaledArousal_RewDiff, scaledPleasantness_RewDiff, scaledDifficult_RewDiff, PosArousal_RewDiff, NegArousal_RewDiff) %>%
  inner_join(y = select(df.diff.pen.cue, SubID, scaledMeanMotivation_PenDiff, scaledArousal_PenDiff, scaledPleasantness_PenDiff, scaledDifficult_PenDiff,PosArousal_PenDiff, NegArousal_PenDiff), by = c("SubID")) %>%
  inner_join(y = select(df.ratings.cue, SubID, scaledMeanMotivation, scaledArousal, scaledPleasantness, scaledDifficult), by = c("SubID")) %>%
  inner_join(y = select(rp_hat, SubID, logR_contrast, logP_contrast), by = c("SubID")) %>%
  inner_join(y = select(traces.v.reward, SubID, mean_v_RewardLevel), by = c("SubID")) %>% 
  inner_join(y = select(traces.v.penalty, SubID, mean_v_PenaltyLevel), by = c("SubID")) %>% 
  inner_join(y = select(traces.v.intercept, SubID, mean_v_Intercept), by = c("SubID")) %>% 
  inner_join(y = select(traces.a.reward, SubID, mean_a_RewardLevel), by = c("SubID")) %>% 
  inner_join(y = select(traces.a.penalty, SubID, mean_a_PenaltyLevel), by = c("SubID")) %>% 
  inner_join(y = select(traces.a.intercept, SubID, mean_a_Intercept), by = c("SubID")) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Motivation_Average = scaledMeanMotivation,
                Motivation_Reward = scaledMeanMotivation_RewDiff,
                Motivation_Penalty = scaledMeanMotivation_PenDiff,
                Arousal_Average = scaledArousal,
                Arousal_Reward = scaledArousal_RewDiff,
                Arousal_Penalty = scaledArousal_PenDiff,
                Pleasant_Average = scaledPleasantness,
                Pleasant_Reward = scaledPleasantness_RewDiff,
                Pleasant_Penalty = scaledPleasantness_PenDiff,
                Difficult_Average = scaledDifficult,
                Difficult_Reward = scaledDifficult_RewDiff,
                Difficult_Penalty = scaledDifficult_PenDiff,
                v_Reward = mean_v_RewardLevel,
                a_Reward = mean_a_RewardLevel,
                v_Penalty = mean_v_PenaltyLevel,
                a_Penalty = mean_a_PenaltyLevel, #) %>%
                v_Intercept = mean_v_Intercept,
                a_Intercept = mean_a_Intercept) %>%
                #LogRT_Reward = scale_Interval_log10_AccRT_RewDiff,
                #Accuracy_Reward = Interval_Acc_RewDiff) %>%
  select(-SubID) %>%
  select(Motivation_Average, Motivation_Reward, Motivation_Penalty,
        Arousal_Average, Arousal_Reward, Arousal_Penalty,
        Pleasant_Average, Pleasant_Reward, Pleasant_Penalty,
        Difficult_Average, Difficult_Reward, Difficult_Penalty,
        PosArousal_RewDiff, PosArousal_PenDiff, NegArousal_RewDiff, NegArousal_PenDiff,
        v_Reward, a_Reward, v_Penalty, a_Penalty, v_Intercept, a_Intercept, logR_contrast, logP_contrast)
corr.diff <- round(cor(df.diff.combined, use = "complete.obs"),3)
pmat.diff <- cor_pmat(df.diff.combined)
pmat.diff.adjusted <- matrix(
  p.adjust(p = as.vector(pmat.diff), method = "BH"),
  nrow = nrow(pmat.diff),
  dimnames = dimnames(pmat.diff)
)
p.diff.rew <- ggcorrplot(corr.diff, 
                p.mat = pmat.diff,
                sig.level = 0.05, 
                insig = "blank", 
                lab = TRUE,
                type = "upper") +
  labs(title = "") 
p.diff.rew

# save plots
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/Corrplot_SelfReport_Parameters.eps"),
  plot = p.diff.rew, bg = "white", device = cairo_ps, width = 10, height = 10, scale = 1.1)
ggsave(filename = paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/Corrplot_SelfReport_Parameters.png"),
  plot = p.diff.rew, bg = "white", device = png, width = 10, height = 10, scale = 1.1)

# Corelation Plot 2 - Figure 5
# Open PDF device
pdf(paste0(datapath.TCBmanuscript,"ddm/Corrplot_SelfReport_Parameters.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
# Plot correlation plot
corrplot(corr.diff, 
  method = "color", 
  type = "upper", 
  p.mat = pmat.diff.adjusted, 
  add = FALSE, 
  sig.level = c(.001,.01,.05), 
  insig = "label_sig", 
  pch.cex = 1.5,
  pch.col = "black",
  tl.pos = "tl",
  tl.col = "black",
  tl.srt = 45)
corrplot(corr.diff, 
  method = "square", 
  type = "lower", 
  p.mat = pmat.diff.adjusted, 
  insig = "blank",

  inner_join(y = select(df.diff.pen.cue, SubID, scaledMeanMotivation_PenDiff, scaledArousal_PenDiff, scaledPleasantness_PenDiff, scaledDifficult_PenDiff,PosArousal_PenDiff, NegArousal_PenDiff), by = c("SubID")) %>%

  inner_join(y = select(traces.v.intercept, SubID, mean_v_Intercept), by = c("SubID")) %>%

                Arousal_Average = scaledArousal,

  select(-SubID) %>%
```

### Correlation Plots Subjective Motivation and Posterior Estimates
```{r}
# High vs Low Reward
p_mot_vRewardLevel<-ggplot(data = df.diff.combined, aes(x = Motivation_Reward, y = v_Reward)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_point(shape = 19, color = "black", size = 4, alpha = 0.7) + 
  #geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x + I(x^2), se = FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, color = "#3C5488") +
  #stat_cor(p.accuracy = 0.001, size = 6, label.x = min(df.diff.combined$Motivation_Reward), label.y = max(df.diff.combined$v_Reward)) +
  labs(x = "Difference in Motivation Rating", y = "Difference in Drift Rate") +
  #scale_fill_npg() + scale_color_npg() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r}
rp_hat_reward <- rp_hat %>%
  select(SubID, logR_LR, logR_HR) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(logR_LR,logR_HR), names_to = "catRewardLevel", values_to = "Rhat") %>%
  mutate(catRewardLevel = factor(catRewardLevel, levels = c("logR_LR","logR_HR"), labels = c("Low Reward", "High Reward")),
        SubID = as.integer(SubID))
View(rp_hat_reward)

df.mediation.reward <- df.interval.cue %>%
  inner_join(y = df.Likert, by = join_by(SubID, CueDisplayed, scaledMotivation, scaledEffort, scaledAttention, scaledArousal, scaledPleasantness, scaledDifficult, scaledMeanMotivation)) %>%
  inner_join(y = rp_hat_reward, by = join_by(SubID, catRewardLevel)) %>%
  group_by(SubID,catRewardLevel) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(scaledMeanMotivation = mean(scaledMeanMotivation, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledMotivation = mean(scaledMotivation, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledEffort = mean(scaledEffort, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledAttention = mean(scaledAttention, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledDifficult = mean(scaledDifficult, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledPleasantness = mean(scaledPleasantness, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scaledArousal = mean(scaledArousal, na.rm = TRUE),
                  PosArousal = mean(PosArousal, na.rm = TRUE),
                  NegArousal = mean(NegArousal, na.rm = TRUE),
                  scale_Interval_log10_AccRT = mean(scale_Interval_log10_AccRT, na.rm = TRUE),
                  Interval_log10_AccRT = mean(Interval_log10_AccRT, na.rm = TRUE),
                  Interval_Acc = mean(Interval_Acc, na.rm = TRUE),
                  Rhat = mean(Rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
```

```{r}
rp_hat_penalty <- rp_hat %>%
  select(SubID, logP_LP, logP_HP) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(logP_LP,logP_HP), names_to = "catPenaltyLevel", values_to = "Phat") %>%
  mutate(catPenaltyLevel = factor(catPenaltyLevel, levels = c("logP_LP","logP_HP"), labels = c("Low Penalty", "High Penalty")),
        SubID = as.integer(SubID))
View(rp_hat_penalty)

df.mediation.penalty <- df.interval.cue %>%

  inner_join(y = rp_hat_penalty, by = join_by(SubID, catPenaltyLevel)) %>%

  dplyr::summarise(scaledMeanMotivation = mean(scaledMeanMotivation, na.rm = TRUE),
```

```{r} 
  inner_join(select(traces.a.IFG_int, SubID, mean_a_IFG_int)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Motivation_Penalty = scaledMeanMotivation_PenDiff,
                Arousal_Penalty = scaledArousal_PenDiff,
                Pleasant_Penalty = scaledPleasantness_PenDiff,
                Difficult_Penalty = scaledDifficult_PenDiff,

                v_VS_int = mean_v_VS_int,

                v_IFG_cue = mean_v_IFG_cue,
                v_IFG_int = mean_v_IFG_int,
                a_IFG_cue = mean_a_IFG_cue,
                a_IFG_int = mean_a_IFG_int,
                v_Reward = mean_v_RewardLevel,

  select(-SubID)

                hc.order = TRUE) +
```
